role.title: Senior Manager - Technology Operations Engineering
role.description:
Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

We are seeking an experienced and technically strong **Senior Manager – Technology Operations Engineering** to lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Application Production Support, and operational excellence for enterprise Contact Center Transformation platforms.

This role will be responsible for ensuring the **end-to-end availability, reliability, performance, scalability, and operational stability** of mission-critical voice platforms, contact center applications, cloud-native services, intelligent voice bots, and AI-powered customer engagement solutions.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP), SRE practices, enterprise application support, Five9, Genesys, telephony technologies, full-stack observability, distributed tracing, and incident management** . The role also requires knowledge of emerging technologies, including Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

The Senior Manager will lead engineering teams responsible for 24x7 production support, proactive monitoring, incident resolution, problem management, change management, automation, and continuous reliability improvements across complex, distributed contact center ecosystems.

 

* **Education & Professional Experience:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with **10+ years of experience** in Technology Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, Application Production Support, or Cloud Engineering, including **5+ years in technical leadership or engineering management roles** .

* **Site Reliability Engineering & Application Support:** Extensive hands-on experience in **SRE, enterprise application production support, distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, application performance troubleshooting, service reliability, and 24x7 production operations** , including on-call support and critical incident resolution.

* **Google Cloud Platform (Mandatory):** Strong hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** and cloud-native technologies, including GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Pub/Sub, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, API Gateway, cloud networking, load balancing, and containerized application environments.

* **Contact Center & Telephony Expertise:** Proven experience supporting **Five9, Genesys, or similar enterprise contact center platforms** , with a strong understanding of telephony architecture, SIP, RTP, IVR, ACD, CTI, call routing, intelligent voice bots, and contact center integrations. Experience with SpeechMiner or comparable speech analytics platforms is highly desirable.

* **Full-Stack Observability & Distributed Tracing:** Strong experience with **Grafana, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, centralized logging, application performance monitoring, and cloud observability tools** , including the ability to implement end-to-end monitoring and troubleshoot complex distributed application issues.

* **AI, Agentic AI & MCP Technologies:** Experience or strong working knowledge of **conversational AI, intelligent voice bots, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers** , including AI workflow observability, execution tracing, integration troubleshooting, and operational reliability.

* **Incident, Problem & Change Management:** Demonstrated expertise in **ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management** , including major incident leadership, root cause analysis, production change coordination, escalation management, on-call operations, and continuous service improvement.

* **Database & Application Integration Technologies:** Hands-on experience supporting **NoSQL databases, Google Cloud Firestore, Oracle Database, APIs, middleware, and distributed application architectures** , with strong troubleshooting capabilities across database performance, connectivity, transaction processing, and enterprise integrations.

* **Networking, Infrastructure & Automation:** Strong understanding of **TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, SIP/RTP, firewalls, load balancers, traffic routing, cloud networking, Kubernetes, and containerized environments** , along with experience in automation, scripting, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as Python, Bash, or Terraform.

* **Technical Leadership & Operational Excellence:** Proven ability to lead engineering teams, manage complex production environments, collaborate across technology organizations, and drive **SRE maturity, operational automation, observability improvements, incident reduction, service reliability, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous engineering excellence** , supported by strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

role.title: Global Head of Deal Strategy and Operations
role.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

**About Us**

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 
 
Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 
 
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

 

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 
 
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Global Head of Deal Strategy and Operations to lead the worldwide deal function for a rapidly scaling data and analytics business formed by the combination of Fivetran and dbt Labs. This is a commercial strategy role as much as an operational one with a mandate to make our deals bigger, better, and faster. The leader owns the deal structures, pricing inputs, policies, and governance that drive more revenue and higher ASP, cleaner and lower-risk terms, and real velocity across every region and segment, while de-risking the business.

This is a pivotal role at a pivotal moment. The business is integrating two commercial engines, two product portfolios, and two sets of systems into a single combined go-to-market. The role sets the strategy for how deals get structured, priced, routed, reviewed, and approved, and acts as a key commercial advisor to GTM leadership on the structures that drive growth, including ELA and commercial strategy, cross-sell, and new product launches. It leads a global team across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC and partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, Systems, Pricing, and Partner Marketplace to keep decisions fast, consistent, and scalable.

This leader is an equal part strategist, operator, and trusted business partner. The ideal candidate moves fluidly between long-term commercial strategy and hands-on problem solving, has a proven track record scaling a deal function in a global, complex, high-growth SaaS environment, and leads teams through change with clarity and conviction.

Reports to the SVP, Strategy and Operations. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in one of our hub offices: New York, NY; Denver, CO; Oakland, CA; or Austin, TX.

**What You'll Do**

* *Team leadership and organizational development*
 + Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing global Deal Desk organization.
 + Coach the team to operate as commercial advisors to the field, raising the strategic value of every interaction with Sales.
 + Build capability and bench strength, reducing key-person dependency as the team scales.
* *Strategic leadership and vision*
 + Own and execute the global vision for the Deal Desk organization across the combined Fivetran + dbt business.
 + Conceptualize and launch new, high-impact commercial strategies and deal constructs (e.g. multi-year deals, shift to consumption-based pricing, and product-specific ELAs) that grow revenue and move the business forward.
 + Lead commercial strategy for the Fivetran + dbt integration, landing one combined operating model, policy set, and deal construct.
 + Build the team structure, governance framework, and ways of working needed to support a global enterprise sales engine selling a multi-product, consumption-based portfolio.
 + Position the deal function as a driver of growth, net revenue retention, and cross-sell, and align the C-suite behind that mandate.
* *Commercial guidance and executive escalation*
 + Provide strategic counsel to senior sales leadership and account teams on complex deal structures, pricing options, concessions, and negotiation strategy.
 + Act as the trusted advisor for high-risk, non-standard, and strategically significant commercial discussions.
 + Engage directly with customers on strategic, high-value negotiations when needed, representing the company with credibility.
* *AI and automation*
 + Set the vision for an AI-native deal desk, deploying agents and automation across the deal lifecycle, including deal-structuring guidance, pricing recommendations, contract and redline review, approval routing, and risk scoring.
 + Build a tiered service model where automation handles standardized, low-risk deals end to end, so the team's time goes to complex, strategic ones.
 + Scale AI-enabled workflows that improve seller productivity, deal quality, approval consistency, and speed, building on an existing foundation of deal-desk AI agents and AI-assisted deal review.
* *Deal governance and cross-functional alignment*
 + Document and enforce global approval policies, SLAs, delegation of authority, and commercial guardrails across Sales, Finance, and Legal.
 + Drive consistency of commercial policy, thresholds, and approval rules across all regions and product lines, so sellers get the same answer wherever a deal originates.
 + Own a standing deal-review and inspection cadence (deal reviews, early checkpoints, and exception tracking) that catches risk early and keeps decisions fast.
 + Partner with Finance and Revenue Accounting to ensure sound revenue recognition, revenue predictability, deal hygiene, and commercial compliance as consumption, ELA, and marketplace structures scale.
* *Deal systems and infrastructure*
 + Lead the strategy and roadmap for deal infrastructure, ensuring scalable, efficient, compliant execution as the two companies converge onto unified quote-to-order systems.
 + Partner with Systems, Legal, and Finance to deliver a unified, high-quality quoting and contracting experience across CPQ, CLM, and order management.
* *New product introduction and pricing operations*
 + Partner with Product, Pricing, and Monetization on new product introduction (NPI), making sure new products and packaging land with a clear deal construct, approval path, and field enablement at launch.
 + Oversee the Pricing Operations function, supporting packaging, SKU rationalization, and consistent, well-governed pricing execution across the portfolio.
* *Marketplace strategy and operations*
 + Oversee marketplace operations across AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks, ensuring a streamlined and compliant transaction experience for customers.
 + Shape policies and operational standards for our marketplace presence, and drive cross-functional alignment with Finance, Product, and vendor partners to optimize transaction efficiency and financial accuracy.

**Skills We're Looking For**

* 15+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Deal Strategy, Revenue Operations or Commercial Operations within a global SaaS or subscription-based business, or Strategy Consulting with a focus on B2B Pricing and Deal Strategy.
* 8+ years of leadership experience scaling high-performing teams, including meaningful time at the director and ideally senior director level.
* Strong command of SaaS pricing strategy, with specific depth in consumption-based pricing, commercial governance, discounting and margin considerations, and contract risk mitigation.
* Track record of building scalable deal processes, implementing robust approval frameworks, and improving deal velocity in complex, high-growth environments.
* Experience structuring deals across both direct and channel motions, including resellers and cloud marketplaces.
* Working knowledge of revenue recognition principles, with a track record of partnering closely with Finance and Revenue Accounting on deal structure.
* Experience applying AI tools to improve deal operations, approval consistency, and seller productivity.
* Proven ability to influence and collaborate with senior executives across Sales, Finance, Legal, Systems, and Product, with exceptional analytical, strategic-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts simply and persuasively.
* Experience with the commercial tooling a deal process runs on (CPQ, CRM, CLM, and related sales systems), enough to be a strong partner to Systems on what is feasible; specific platform experience such as Salesforce or Ironclad is a plus, not a requirement.
* Experience leading through M&A, systems integration, or large-scale organizational change is a strong plus.

#LIHYBRID #LI-SR1

**Perks and Benefits**

* 100% employer-paid medical insurance**\***
* Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
* RSU stock grants\*
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

* *May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information*

*Click* *here* *to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*

We're honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we're proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.*

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
### **At Materion, everyone is included, respected and offered opportunity to grow.** ***Join us!***

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Operations, Premium Targets provides strategic and operational leadership for a complex, multi-site manufacturing organization with domestic and international operations. This leader is accountable for safety, quality, delivery, cost, customer performance, talent development, capital execution, and continuous improvement. The individual in this role will lead Operations, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams, including manufacturing facilities across multiple locations. As the organization’s senior operations safety leader, the Director sets clear expectations, models visible safety leadership, empowers employees to identify and address hazards, and holds leaders accountable for proactive risk reduction and continuous EHS improvement. Working across Technology, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial, Engineering, EHS, and other functions, the Director translates business priorities into sustainable results, standardizes manufacturing and business processes, and delivers exceptional service to internal and external customers. The role also leads operations strategy and financial performance, including gross margin, inventory turns, and cost management.

**Operations Leadership and Execution**
=======================================

* Lead a proactive, prevention-focused safety culture in which every employee is empowered and expected to identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and take ownership of a safe and healthy workplace.
* Lead manufacturing operations across Buffalo, Wheatfield, Albuquerque, Limerick, and Brewster, with strong matrix partnerships supporting Alzenau and Taiwan.
* Own performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, and customer commitments; establish clear metrics, review performance routinely, and hold site leaders accountable for results.
* Set and execute the Premium Targets operations strategy, multi-year roadmap, and long-range capital and workforce plans.
* Ensure facilities consistently deliver high-quality products on time to internal business units and external customers.
* Partner with Technology, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial, Engineering, EHS, and other functions to align priorities and improve end-to-end performance.
* Develop, coach, and hold operational leaders accountable for business results, team effectiveness, and talent growth.
* Strengthen communication, operating discipline, and knowledge sharing across all Premium Targets facilities.
* Provide clear, timely business updates and recommendations to senior leaders and key stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence, Strategy, and Capital Leadership**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Champion EHS excellence by ensuring regulatory compliance, audit readiness, effective risk assessments, timely incident and near-miss investigation, corrective-action closure, and consistent use of leading and lagging safety indicators.
* Serve as executive sponsor for the Premium Targets Lean manufacturing transformation.
* Advance daily management, structured problem solving, kaizen, standard work, process improvement, and cost-reduction practices across sites.
* Partner with Lean resources and site leaders to implement improvements and sustain measurable gains.
* Lead major capital programs, equipment installations, expansions, and facility transitions in partnership with Engineering, corporate, business-unit, and capital teams.
* Ensure capital initiatives meet approved cost, schedule, quality, and performance objectives while integrating safety into design, installation, commissioning, and startup.
* Develop manufacturing and supply chain strategies that support production, maintenance, planning, EHS, technical capability, and customer requirements.
* Partner with Commercial teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
* Enable best-practice sharing and process standardization across manufacturing locations.
* Lead financial performance improvement, with a focus on gross margin, inventory turns, and cost management.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, business, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of progressive experience in a manufacturing environment, including significant manufacturing operations people leadership responsibility with a demonstrated ability to develop leaders and build high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated success leading safety and EHS performance, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement, engineering, and capital projects.
* Ability to lead end-to-end processes and deliver results through cross-functional and matrixed teams.
* Ability to travel up to 50%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in engineering, business administration, or a related field.
* Leadership experience in a multi-site or international manufacturing organization.
* Experience leading a Lean transformation or enterprise-wide operating system.
* Experience managing major capital programs, facility expansions, installations, or transitions.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and systems-oriented thinking, with the ability to translate business priorities into executable operating plans.
* Strong influence, collaboration, and negotiation skills, including the ability to secure alignment and resources across functions.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication with team members, peers, customers, and senior leaders.
* Sound judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguity, reconcile differing viewpoints, and make timely decisions.
* Visible, values-based leadership grounded in safety, integrity, accountability, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated commitment to coaching, succession planning, and the growth of talent across all levels.

Pay Range:

$148,500.00 - $237,100.00

*Actual base salary offered varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location.*

**The selection of the person to be hired for this position is contingent on the candidate having export compliance eligibility for access to U.S. controlled technology which comes under the licensing jurisdiction of the U.S. Department of State, International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the U.S. Department of Commerce, Export Administration Regulations (EAR).**

**The candidate selected will have to qualify as either a U.S. citizen, a U.S. National, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., a Person Admitted into the U.S. as an Asylee or Refugee., a National of a country that is not prohibited from having access to U.S. controlled technology (via a letter of assurance), or a Person to be approved for an export license by the governing agency whose technology comes under its jurisdiction. Please understand that any job offer that requires approval of an export license will be conditional on Materion’s determination that it will be able to obtain an export license in a time frame consistent with Materion’s business requirements.**

**Materion Corporation and its subsidiaries (the “Company”) is an equal employment opportunity employer. It is the Company’s policy to not unlawfully discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also the Company’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions. The information collected by this application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity and maintain employment statistics on applicants.**

**Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on the Company. Please inform the Company’s personnel representative if you need assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process.**

**Materion’s Veteran Employee Resource group supports veterans and promotes the benefits of hiring veterans in the workplace. We honor all those who have served and are a military friendly company. Veterans are encouraged to apply and military experience and skills are transferrable to Materion careers.**

role.description:
**About dss+**

At dss+, you don’t just deliver projects. You help save lives, improve performance, and build a more sustainable future. We are a purpose-led global consultancy helping organizations solve complex challenges across Operational Risk, Operational Excellence, and Sustainability. With roots in DuPont’s industrial operations, we combine deep industry expertise with practical implementation to deliver measurable, lasting results.

**Why This Role**

As a Senior Manager within our Industrials & Manufacturing team, you will play a key role in delivering transformational results for clients while contributing to the growth of our business. You will build trusted client relationships, identify and develop new business opportunities, support the shaping and closing of consulting engagements, and lead complex projects from the boardroom to the plant floor.

Our work spans industrial manufacturing, consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, and building products, helping clients improve safety, operational performance, productivity, reliability, and profitability.

**What You’ll Experience at dss+**

**Meaningful Impact**

Help leading industrial and manufacturing organizations improve safety, performance, resilience, and sustainability.

**Trusted Expertise**

Work alongside industry experts and senior client leaders to solve complex operational challenges.

**Growth & Leadership**

Take on significant client, project, and business development responsibility while developing teams and helping shape the growth of dss+.

**A Collaborative Culture**

Join a purpose-led, inclusive organization where different perspectives, expertise, and ideas are valued.

**Your Impact**

**Grow the Business**

* Own and deliver against defined annual business development and sales targets.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with senior Operations and EHS leaders.
* Identify new opportunities within existing and prospective client accounts.
* Support the shaping, development, pricing, and closing of consulting engagements.
* Expand client relationships by bringing the full breadth of dss+ capabilities to clients.
* Contribute to industry networks, client events, proposals, and thought leadership.

**What You Bring**

* 10+ years of experience in management consulting and/or manufacturing leadership.
* Senior consulting and/or significant operational, project, or plant leadership experience.
* Proven experience contributing to business development, developing client opportunities, and working toward defined annual sales targets.
* Strong client relationship skills with the ability to build credibility with senior Operations and EHS leaders.
* Demonstrated project and program management experience, including leading complex engagements, managing multiple workstreams, budgets, timelines, resources, risks, and client expectations.
* Experience leading large-scale safety, operational excellence, and performance transformations with measurable results.
* Turnaround, restructuring, and/or M&A integration experience.
* Strong knowledge of Operational Excellence, Lean/Six Sigma, safety management systems, and large-scale change.
* Strong executive presence with credibility in both the boardroom and on the plant floor.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a related field; MBA preferred.

**A Bit More About Us**

dss+ is a global operations management consulting firm helping organizations improve safety, operational performance, and sustainability.

We work from the boardroom to the plant floor, combining deep industry expertise with practical implementation to deliver lasting results.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected, valued, and able to contribute and grow.

role.title: Sr. Manager, Fab Quality Engineering
role.description:
**Location:** Alhambra, CA (Onsite)

 

**Our Team**

SPP is a vertically integrated photonics business focused on the design, fabrication, and delivery of Indium Phosphide (InP) semiconductor laser and gain chips. SPP operates two wafer fabrication facilities in Southern California supporting advanced photonic devices and customer die demand.

 

**Job Summary**

The Sr. Manager, Fab Quality Engineering serves as the senior quality leader within SPP Operations and is responsible for building and leading the manufacturing quality organization across both fabrication facilities. The role establishes quality systems, inspection practices, quality metrics, and quality culture while partnering closely with Operations, Engineering, and the Sr. Manager, Photonics Quality Engineering to support business growth and manufacturing excellence.

This position provides leadership for manufacturing quality strategy, execution, and organizational development across both fabrication facilities and is expected to maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor. The role supports Epitaxial Growth, Wafer Fabrication, Bar Processing, Chip Processing, and Test Operations, and works closely with Epitaxy, Process, Product, and Equipment Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Planning, Supply Chain, Test Operations, and Reliability & Failure Analysis.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and lead the SPP Fab Quality organization across both fabrication facilities
* Recruit, develop, and manage quality inspectors while building future technician and quality engineering capabilities
* Establish quality procedures, metrics, escalation processes, reporting systems, and a culture of quality ownership and continuous improvement.
* Establish incoming inspection processes, acceptance criteria, and material-control procedures for critical materials including III-V substrates, epitaxial source materials, specialty gases, precious metals, process chemicals, and optical and test consumables
* Verify material certifications; establish supplier qualification, monitoring, corrective-action, and containment processes
* Ensure traceability and disposition tracking.
* Develop and implement in-process quality control systems, containment and escalation processes for quality excursions, and process controls across manufacturing operations
* Monitor process performance and quality trends
* Drive reduction of defects, scrap, rework, and quality escapes; and ensure consistent quality practices across both fabs.
* Implement and maintain manufacturing quality systems, including Statistical Process Control (SPC), CAPA, Non-Conforming Material Report (NCMR) processes, FMEA, and process control plans
* Provide independent quality review and approval of Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), process changes, and manufacturing transfers
* Establish and maintain ESD control programs and quality documentation and records.
* Lead investigations of manufacturing quality excursions and process escapes in partnership with Process Engineering and Product Engineering
* Monitor process capability (Cp/Cpk)
* Provide quality leadership for measurement-system capability and MSA activities
* Support tool and process qualification and requalification
* Use quality data to improve process stability, defect reduction, and yield.
* Maintain audit readiness across both fabrication facilities
* Support internal, customer, and ISO audits
* Support contamination-control initiatives and cleanroom environmental monitoring
* Ensure quality documentation meets compliance requirements
* Partner with the Sr. Manager, Photonics Quality Engineering on corporate quality initiatives and enterprise quality alignment.
Other relevant tasks, as assigned. 

 
 

**Minimum Qualifications (Education & Experience)**

role.title: Director of Quality Engineering
role.description:
The Director of Quality Engineering – Automation & Performance is the senior technical, delivery, and practice leader for iLAB U.S. Automation and Performance Testing. The role is accountable for the day-to-day management of U.S. engineering initiatives and resources, while also providing hands-on consulting leadership for strategic clients.

This leader defines the practice strategy, architecture, standards, delivery assurance, reusable solutions, and capability roadmap for Automation and Performance Testing. Working as part of a global delivery organization, they combine technical credibility, client leadership, people management, and commercial judgment to deliver measurable quality outcomes, strengthen service offerings, and build scalable engineering capability.

* Own the day-to-day delivery, prioritization, staffing, allocation, utilization, performance, and technical direction of all iLAB U.S. Automation and Performance Testing initiatives and resources.
* Define and evolve Automation and Performance Testing strategies, capability roadmaps, service offerings, architectures, standards, frameworks, methods, tools, reusable accelerators, and intellectual property.
* Oversee technical assurance across high-impact deliveries, including solution architecture, automation and performance engineering design, CI/CD integration, AI-enabled engineering guardrails, test-data readiness, and environment readiness.
* Lead critical client-facing activities, including technical discovery, project kickoffs, solutioning workshops, executive presentations, steering reviews, escalations, and project recovery.
* Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex or at-risk engagements and personally provide architecture, assessment, technical review, troubleshooting, and recovery leadership until delivery is stabilized.
* Lead the technical development and review of RFIs, RFPs, proposals, SOWs, estimates, staffing models, assumptions, deliverables, risks, acceptance criteria, and service commitments
* Establish and oversee practical engineering governance, including quality gates, code and architecture reviews, documentation standards, source-control practices, repository security, and technical approval processes.
* Define and guide responsible, value-focused uses of AI within Automation and Performance Testing, including test design assistance, script development and maintenance, results analysis, defect insight, and knowledge retrieval, while applying company security, privacy, data-handling, and human-review requirements
* Hire, coach, develop, and retain engineering managers, architects, principal engineers, and technical specialists; establish competency expectations, career paths, succession plans, and backup coverage for critical capabilities.
* Collaborate with global delivery leaders to align technical standards, share reusable assets and expertise, and support other geographies with strategic client and delivery needs.
* Partner with Sales, Professional Services, Operations, Finance, and Talent Management on capacity planning, forecasting, utilization, delivery margin and growth opportunities.
* Represent iLAB as a Quality Engineering thought leader through conferences, industry events, client advisory councils, publications, demonstrations, and market-facing content.

* At least 15 years of progressive experience in Quality Engineering, including senior leadership of complex Automation and Performance Testing solutions, consulting engagements, engineering teams, and CxO-level client relationships
* Deep knowledge of Automation and Performance Testing strategies, architectures, frameworks, tools, workload models, execution practices, analysis, reporting, and integration with modern software delivery pipelines
* Experience leading technical delivery across multiple clients, programs, or business units, including distributed teams and critical project recovery.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD integration, testability, observability, test-data and environment readiness, cloud delivery, and AI-assisted engineering practices.
* Proven people leadership, including resource planning, coaching, performance management, prioritization, utilization, and organizational development.
* Strong consulting and client-advisory skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions and delivery plans.
* Experience shaping proposals, SOWs, estimates, resource models, and commercial commitments.
* Sound understanding of consulting engagement economics, including forecasting, utilization, margin, cost-to-serve, and measurable client outcomes.
* A mature, politically astute leadership style; calm in a crisis, able to lead by influence and example, with excellent written and oral communication.
* Willing and able to travel interstate and occasionally internationally for critical client-facing initiatives, project kickoffs, workshops, presentations, escalations, and recovery efforts.
* Demonstrated experience in a Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Automation, or Performance Testing consulting or professional-services organization.
* Experience across the consulting lifecycle and multi-country delivery teams; relevant industry expertise and advanced professional certifications are beneficial.

role.title: Director, Quality Engineering
role.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that enable exceptional member and provider experiences. 
The Director, Quality Engineering – Test Data Management (EQE) is a senior technology leader responsible for defining, advancing, and operating Humana's enterprise Test Data Management (TDM) function within Enterprise Quality Engineering. Reporting to the VP, Quality Engineering, this role leads the strategy, operating model, and execution of secure, scalable, compliant, and automation-enabled test data capabilities that support software delivery across Humana's business and technology organizations. 
This leader is accountable for building and leading a high-performing organization responsible for core TDM services, including test data provisioning, synthetic data generation, masking, de-identification, data lifecycle management, and environment data coordination. The Director will partner closely with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Risk, and Data teams to ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to delivery, compliance, and release readiness needs. 
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in test data management, data engineering, governance, privacy, and automation in a complex enterprise environment. This role will drive modernization of TDM practices through automation-first and AI-enabled capabilities, while establishing standards, controls, and reusable services that improve engineering throughput, reduce delivery friction, and strengthen compliance and data protection across non-production environments.

**Responsibilities**

**Leadership, Strategy & Operating Model**

* Lead the enterprise Test Data Management function within EQE, including strategic direction, operating model execution, and organizational development.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of managers, engineers, and test data specialists across multiple groups supporting segment and enterprise needs.
* Oversee a distributed organization of **50+ associates** and create clear priorities, role clarity, and performance expectations.
* Partner with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data teams to align TDM services with business and delivery priorities.
* Drive a scalable support model for segment TDM services across multiple portfolios and delivery teams.
* Promote a culture of quality, compliance, continuous improvement, and shared ownership of secure test data practices.

**Test Data Engineering & Management**

 

* Lead enterprise engineering and management of secure, scalable, and compliant test data solutions.
* Oversee delivery of core TDM capabilities, including:Test data provisioningSynthetic data generationData masking and obfuscationData de-identificationData quality enablementTest data automationData lifecycle managementEnvironment data coordination
* Ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to quality engineering, release, and environment needs.
* Advance data engineering practices that improve the reliability, reusability, and speed of test data provisioning across delivery pipelines.
* Support complex testing needs across functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and non-production validation use cases.

**AI-Enabled & Automation-First TDM**

 

* Drive **AI-enabled** and automation-first TDM strategies to improve speed, intelligence, scalability, and coverage of test data operations.
* Expand the use of AI and advanced automation for synthetic data generation, sensitive data detection, masking rule optimization, provisioning efficiency, and data quality insights.
* Integrate TDM automation into CI/CD and engineering workflows where applicable to reduce manual effort and increase release confidence.
* Partner with enterprise engineering and platform teams to modernize TDM tooling, workflows, and reusable patterns.
* Establish metrics to evaluate automation effectiveness, data readiness, cycle time reduction, and business value realization.

**Governance, Standards, Compliance & Privacy**

 

* Define and enforce enterprise TDM standards, governance, and operating policies.
* Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and regulatory requirements related to test data usage, storage, movement, masking, and de-identification.
* Oversee implementation of compliance and privacy controls for non-production data usage.
* Establish standards for secure handling of production-like data in test environments.
* Partner with security, risk, privacy, and compliance stakeholders to maintain appropriate controls and audit readiness.
* Promote consistent governance for test data access, retention, refresh, lineage, and lifecycle management.

**Delivery Enablement & Stakeholder Partnership**

 

* Enable delivery teams through timely, compliant, and high-quality test data services that improve engineering throughput and release readiness.
* Partner with segment quality engineering leaders and application teams to understand demand patterns and align TDM support to delivery roadmaps.
* Coordinate across environments and shared services to reduce delays related to data setup, refresh, and availability.
* Influence engineering and quality practices that improve testability, environment readiness, and quality outcomes.
* Collaborate with enterprise enablement and platform teams to standardize capabilities and reduce duplication.

**Metrics, Governance & Continuous Improvement**

 

* Define and monitor KPIs related to test data availability, provisioning speed, automation adoption, compliance adherence, data quality, and operational efficiency.
* Use data and insights to identify risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities across TDM services.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce manual work, increase data reliability, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Provide clear reporting and operational transparency to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build maturity roadmaps for enterprise TDM capabilities and measure progress against defined outcomes.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or any technology related degree or equivalent experience.
* **10+ years** of experience in quality engineering, test data management, data engineering, software engineering, or related technical disciplines.
* **5+ years** of leadership experience managing enterprise-scale technology teams, including managers and geographically distributed associates.
* Experience leading or scaling **test data management**, data engineering, or quality engineering functions in a large enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated success building and operating secure, scalable, and compliant test data solutions.
* Experience with key TDM capabilities such as data provisioning, masking, obfuscation, de-identification, synthetic data generation, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of privacy, security, and compliance considerations for test data in regulated environments.
* Experience driving automation and process modernization across engineering or quality workflows.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, quality, data, and business organizations.
* Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments and supporting modern software delivery practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Experience in healthcare, payer/insurance, or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience supporting enterprise quality engineering or platform enablement organizations.
* Familiarity with test data management platforms, masking tools, synthetic data solutions, and data quality tooling.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise engineering platforms.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning capabilities to test data, quality engineering, or operational optimization.
* Familiarity with data governance, data retention, and environment management practices in large-scale enterprises.

**Success in this Role**

In this role, success will be measured by:

* Improved speed, reliability, and scalability of enterprise test data provisioning and support.
* Increased adoption of secure, compliant, and reusable TDM solutions across segments and teams.
* Reduced delivery delays caused by test data availability, quality, or environment coordination issues.
* Strong compliance with privacy, security, masking, and de-identification requirements.
* Measurable advancement in AI-enabled and automation-first TDM capabilities.
* Improved stakeholder satisfaction across Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, and Delivery teams.
* Strong associate engagement, capability growth, and retention across the TDM organization.

In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. role.title: Director-Government and External Quality Programs
role.description:
**Job Description:**

The Director of Government and External Quality Programs sets the enterprise vision and strategy for government quality and public reporting programs. This role anticipates regulatory and policy changes, represents Intermountain externally, establishes standards and governance, and mobilizes organizational partners to improve quality performance, manage risk, and optimize financial outcomes. The Leader also builds and develops a sustainable center of expertise responsible for accurate, timely, and defensible reporting.

**Essential Functions**

* Sets the enterprise vision and strategy for government quality and public reporting programs. Anticipates the future environment, establishes strategic priorities, and aligns the portfolio with Intermountain’s clinical, financial, and operational goals.
* Shapes Intermountain’s response to evolving policy and regulation. Interprets emerging government priorities, evaluates enterprise impact, and advises senior leaders on strategic decisions, risks, opportunities, and organizational readiness.
* Develops Intermountain’s positions and represents the organization externally. Builds enterprise alignment and serves as a senior representative in government, industry, advisory, and measure-development forums to influence practical and meaningful quality programs.
* Builds strategic partnerships that expand Intermountain’s influence. Cultivates senior-level relationships with government agencies, associations, health systems, health plans, and national quality leaders to anticipate change, shape strategy, and advance shared priorities.
* Establishes enterprise standards for quality measurement and reporting. Provides strategic oversight of measure interpretation, data integrity, abstraction, submission, and public reporting to ensure results are consistent, timely, and defensible.
* Drives enterprise quality performance and financial value. Mobilizes clinical, operational, financial, and technical leaders around priority opportunities and ensures government quality programs translate into measurable improvement and optimized organizational outcomes.
* Establishes governance and executive accountability for program risk. Ensures senior leaders have visibility into performance, financial exposure, readiness, and emerging concerns. Directs the organizational response to significant reporting issues, disputes, and adverse determinations.
* Builds and leads an enterprise center of expertise. Provides strategic direction to government quality reporting teams, develops leaders and subject matter experts, and ensures the organization has the talent, technology, partnerships, and resources needed for long-term success.
 

**Skills**

* Strategic Leadership
* Strategic Planning
* Regulatory Interpretation
* Policy Analysis
* External Relations and Advocacy
* Executive Influence and Communication
* Quality Measurement and Reporting
* Performance Improvement
* Risk Management
* Financial Acumen
* Relationship Building
* Communication

**Minimum Qualifications**

role.title: Sr Director - Advanced Therapies External Manufacturing
role.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
 
 
**Organization Overview:** 
The Senior Director Advanced Therapies External Manufacturing Operations is responsible for providing leadership and oversight for the production operations of Advanced Therapies contract manufacturers (CMs) under the oversight of the Lebanon Advanced Therapies Manufacturing site, integrating all functional requirements to ensure quality, safety, and customer requirements are met through the lifecycle of external partnerships (partner selection, technology transfer, operation, relationship exit). This position will work cross-functionally to build a business plan, meet commitments, and drive continuous improvement.
 
 
**Responsibilities:** 

* Ensuring staff are qualified and that the required initial and continuing training of all operations personnel is carried out and adapted according to need.
* Accountable for the execution of Lilly standards of operational excellence as it applies to each of the CM relationships
* Relationship development with each CM in order to ensure baseline governance of the contractual obligations and deliver value creation
* Staffs and leads a cross-functional team to execute the expectations outlined in Lilly’s standards of operational excellence
* Establish required Process Teams, complying with the expectations established in Lilly’s standards of operational excellence
* Lead required Flow teams comprised of engineering, technical services and quality functional leaders, complying with the expectations established in Lilly’s standards of operational excellence
* Accountable to communicate status and issues to various management levels in manufacturing, quality, commercial, research and development networks
* Serve as a member of the Lebanon Advanced Therapies Manufacturing site lead team to ensure continuity across internal and external manufacturing processes

**Basic Requirements:** 

* High-quality skills to include: Teamwork and interpersonal, technical, leadership, project management, administrative, financial background, organizational, independent, decision making, multi-tasking, ability to influence diverse groups, communication skills, computer skills, and problem solving.
* Good understanding of OSSCE and its integration within a plant.
* Relevant foundational experiences in process engineering, quality control, process development or technical services.
* Administrative experience as a leader of operations or technical support functions.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemistry/Biochemistry or related science

**Additional Information:** 
Up to 15-20% travel will be required
 
Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
 
 
Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
 
 
Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).
 
 
Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is
 
$168,000 - $246,400
 
 
Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
Location:

Horsham, PA, US, 19044

Business Unit: Sensor, Test & Calibration

Posting Date: Nov 6, 2026

Job Description:

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading all daily operations of the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, high-quality, and cost-effective production. This role oversees production, safety, quality, maintenance, shipping, warehousing, staffing, budgeting, and continuous improvement while supporting company goals, customer requirements, and regulatory compliance.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:**

Facility & Maintenance

* Responsible for leading maintenance, facilities upkeep, asset reliability, and repair operations within plant.
* Respond to emergency repair situations and provide leadership for urgent maintenance needs, including factory visits when required.
* Ensures that production equipment, building systems, utilities, and facility infrastructure operate safely, efficiently, and reliably.
* Oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs for production equipment, heavy machinery, manufacturing utilities, and facility systems.
* Develop and manage maintenance schedules to reduce machine downtime, improve reliability, and extend equipment life.
* Inspect facilities, equipment, and infrastructure regularly to identify issues early and ensure timely corrective action.
* Coordinate repair and maintenance projects involving mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, fire suppression, security, lifts, cranes, and general building systems.
* Implement and enforce workplace safety policies and standards, including electrical safety, lockout/tagout, fire safety, hot work, and related compliance requirements.
* Lead root-cause analysis investigations for equipment failures and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Supervise mechanical and electrical technicians, assign work, monitor performance, and support training and skill development.
* Source, coordinate, and oversee external contractors and vendors, including service-level agreements and project execution.

Operational Leadership:

* Direct and manage daily plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, shipping, warehousing, and support functions.
* Ensure production schedules, shipment commitments, and customer requirements are met safely, efficiently, and on time.
* Enforce company safety policies, OSHA requirements, environmental procedures, and regulatory standards to maintain a safe workplace.
* Lead, coach, train, and develop employees/ team while promoting accountability, teamwork, and employee engagement.
* Manage labor, materials, equipment, and operating expenses to meet cost, productivity, and business objectives.
* Support operational planning, capital improvement recommendations, staffing plans, and business growth initiatives.
 

**EXPERIENCE/REQUIREMENTS:**

Essential Skills

* Strong leadership, coaching, and team-building abilities.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, safety, quality, maintenance, inventory, and shipping processes.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to analyze operational data, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced production environment.
* Commitment to safety, quality, accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Performance Expectations

* Meet or exceed safety, quality, production, shipment, cost, and productivity targets.
* Maintain a safe, organized, compliant, and efficient manufacturing environment.
* Improve operational performance through effective leadership, problem solving, and continuous improvement.
* Develop employees to strengthen plant capability and succession planning.
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, employee engagement, and customer focus.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent manufacturing leadership experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive leadership experience in a manufacturing, production, or industrial environment.
* Experience leading hourly employees, and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing safety, quality, production performance, budgets, staffing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental, quality, and workplace safety requirements.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with ERP systems preferred.
 

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout a manufacturing facility for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull materials or equipment as required by plant operations.
* Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with noise, moving equipment, varying temperatures, and standard safety requirements.
* Ability to use personal protective equipment as required.
* Ability to climb stairs, bend, reach, and visually inspect production areas, equipment, and workstations.

role.description:
**You’ve discovered something special. A company that cares. Cares about leading the way in construction, engineering, manufacturing and renewable energy. Cares about redefining how energy is designed, applied and consumed. Cares about thoughtfully growing to meet market demands. And as “one of the Healthiest 100 Workplaces in America” is focused on the mind/body/soul of team members through our** **Culture of Care** **.**

The Plant Manager role is strategic and people-driven and will lead all aspects of manufacturing operations within our facility. This role is responsible for driving performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and team culture. The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in Lean Manufacturing, a commitment to developing people, and a passion for operational excellence.

As Plant Manager, you will play a key role in executing our Lean Operating System and ensuring alignment with company goals and values, including our key behaviors of: People First, We Work Together, and We Learn and Grow.

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**

Education: Bachelor’s degree in manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Business, Operations Management or a related field. (Master’s preferred). Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, or similar experience preferred.

Experience: 7+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including 3+ years as a Plant or Operations Manager, with a proven track record of implementing and sustaining Lean Manufacturing principles. role.title: Plant Manager - NRO
role.description:
Location:
Chicago, IL, US

Req ID: 42252

Date: Nov 6, 2026

The ASR Group® family of companies make up the world’s largest refiner and marketer of cane sugar. The companies produce a full line of grocery, industrial, foodservice and specialty sweetener products. Across North America, ASR Group® companies operate five sugar refineries, located in California, Maryland, Louisiana, Canada and Mexico. In Europe, ASR Group® companies operate sugar refineries in the United Kingdom, Portugal, and, with a joint venture partner, Italy. The companies also farm sugarcane and own sugar mills in Mexico and Belize. The ASR Group® portfolio includes the leading brands Domino®, C&H®, Florida Crystals®, Redpath®, Tate & Lyle®, Lyle's®, Sidul® and Whitworths®. ASR Group® companies also produce and market Tellus®, a single-use, compostable tableware and foodservice product made from plant fibers, including sugarcane.

 

**Overview**
------------

The ASR Group Chicago plant is a sugar melt & packaging operation, producing a variety of sugar products for customers. The Calumet facility is blending and packing molasses products for further industrial application. We are looking for a Plant Manager to join our team who is a hands-on leader with excellent problem-solving skills and a drive for improvement and success.

 

This position is accountable for managing the overall results of the Chicago and Calumet facilities to ensure safe, reliable and efficient manufacturing operations and support functions required to meet the business objectives and the expectations of our customers.

**Detailed Roles and Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

* Oversees and champions an effective safety program to achieve zero injuries and continuous improvement to both physical safety issues and employee safety attitudes and behaviors

* Promotes a high level of quality and ensures adherence to all Food Safety Standards, requirements and Good Manufacturing Practices.

* Directs, plans and organizes all manufacturing operations including packaging, maintenance, utilities, engineering and quality.

* Ensures that the productivity and efficiency performance required to meet the key results and objectives of the business are achieved with the highest service standards that will exceed our customer’s expectations.

* Ensures that the site operates within all environmental standards and requirements at all times. Maintains positive dealings with all regulatory agencies.

* Implements manufacturing strategies and plans to ensure that the plant supports Redpath and ASR strategic initiatives. Identifies and recommends opportunities to develop and execute the capital improvement plan to support growth of the business.

* Establishes group and individual accountabilities in all departments for problem solving, cost reduction, and continuous improvement. Ensures focus on problem-solving and use of new technologies.

* Improves utilization of manpower in all areas and improves levels of training, knowledge, and skills within the operations group at all levels.

* Develops and oversees operating budgets. Manages spending against budget and implement strategies to improve costs.

* Maintains positive and productive employee relations by promoting constructive and collaborative relations with all employees.

* Establishes practices throughout the organization to foster positive involvement by all employees with opportunity for input and action.

* Manages community relations and deals with city, municipal and government initiatives that will have impact on the site.

* Supports new product development and sales initiatives.

* Work effectively and ensure that food safety, authenticity, legality, and quality are maintained.

* Report any risks or any evidence of unsafe or out-of-specification product, equipment, packaging or raw materials, to a designated manager to enable the resolution of issues requiring immediate action.

**Education and/or Experience**
-------------------------------

WORK EXPERIENCES

* Minimum of 5 to 10 years’ experience in food manufacturing or processing industry

* 3 to 5 years’ experience in a management role overseeing multiple functions and disciplines

* Previous project management and / or project execution experience is expected.

* Strong technical knowledge of packaging and food processing systems

* Demonstrated experience managing and implementing Continuous improvement projects

* Excellent interpersonal and communications skills with abilities to lead, motivate and develop people

* Strong planning, analytical and organizational skills

 

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

* University degree in engineering, operations management or business preferred

**Essential Capabilities / Competencies**
-----------------------------------------

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY

* Responsible for overall direction and supervision of a 20 plus person workforce across two facilities.

 

ESSENTIAL CAPABILITIES (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES AND PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES)

* Strong leadership, organizational and communication skills in a cross-functional role.

* Excellent interpersonal relationship skills focusing on teamwork and collaboration within all levels of the business.

* Highly analytical yet comfortable using judgment to drive recommendations and decisions with imperfect information.

* Proficiency with MS Office a must. Experience with SAP a plus.

**Location of Role**
--------------------

LOCATION OF ROLE

Chicago, IL

 

This developmental role is part of a rotational program designed to build multi-site leadership capabilities and prepare the successful candidate to advance from smaller operations to a larger, more complex role within the ASR network at a refinery in Crockett, CA; New Orleans, LA; or Baltimore, MD.

Pay Range: $119,000 - $221,000

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other category protected under federal, state, or local law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

*Be a hero for our rare disease patients*

At Ultragenyx, we fundamentally believe that taking real impactful action to care for the needs of patients and our people is always the right thing to do. Our commitment and care for patients extends to our people, so culture is an essential cornerstone for Ultragenyx. We remain continuously focused on creating a supportive and inclusive environment of profound learning and growth – so employees can thrive in all areas of their lives, in and outside of work. Ultimately, we want to be an organization where we would be proud for our family, friends and children to work.

If you want to have a meaningful impact, do the best work of your career, and grow a lot, both professionally and personally, come join our team*.*

### **Position Summary:**

***ultra****focused – Work together to fearlessly uncover new possibilities*

The Upstream Manufacturing Manager will report to the Sr. Director of Upstream Manufacturing. The role will be responsible for the supervision of a shift of 5 manufacturing technicians and Associates on a rotating pitman (every other weekend off) 12 hour schedule (7am-7pm). The roles primary focus will be on cell culture operations from vial thaw through to 2K operations for the production of viral particles for gene therapy products.

Core Lab & Ops: This role typically requires that the majority of the work be conducted on-site.

* Ensure Business System Ownership (BSO) ownership of the equipment and facility is demonstrated at all times.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Plant manager will provide leadership and direction to ensure the continual, efficient and uniform operation which will meet or exceed customer expectations in a safe and orderly manner.
 
He/she will develop and implement plans coordinated with the Corporate Business Plan to increase the reliability and continually improve the quality and efficiencies of the products and services provided by the business unit.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Supervise branch production using RMAS Warehouse Management System and available Production Planning tools
* Develop plans and procedures to insure the safety of all employees and visitors of the warehouse and Clarify and correct any incorrect warehouse procedures
* Ensure operations and equipment is in compliance to corporate guidelines and OSHA Standards
* Verify inventory and make adjustments where necessary
* Hire, train and motivate warehouse employees to build bench strength and increase retention by scheduling and provide training for growth and compliance
* Maintain equipment to provide maximum availability and minimum down time
* Evaluate and recommend new equipment purchases to enhance quality, capabilities and productivity
* Communicate and monitor progress towards company safety, returns and allowances, and on time shipment and delivery directives
* Responsible for building maintenance and security
* Monitor quality and process improvement throughout the warehouse using SAP reports
* Ensure that preventive and corrective action methods are followed to eliminate or correct procedures and practices which do not meet customer requirements
* Follow progressive disciplinary action to adhere to policy and procedures
* Ensure adequate support of the sales department and its customers in a timely and orderly manner
* Assist with customer problems, including on-site visits where necessary
* Facilitate Lean practices in the Plant
* Purchase or direct the purchase of necessary warehouse supplies to insure the ability to comply with written work instructions and customer requirements
* Attend regional and corporate meetings when required
* Perform employee reviews as required
* Assist in contract negotiations, where applicable
* This is a position that works directly on the warehouse floor on or around heavy machinery
* Meets TKMNA Employee Attributes/Competencies

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirement for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

* Bachelor's degree preferred (in a Business, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Behavioral Science curriculum)
* Two years direct Warehouse Supervision or team leadership, experience
* Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Office application, Excel, Word, Access and PowerPoint a must

role.title: Sr. Director Operational Excellence
role.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
