role.title: Director of Quality Assurance
role.description:
**Corporate Overview**

Aluris Sciences is a contract manufacturing organization (CMO) headquartered in Carlsbad, CA with over 50,000 square feet of manufacturing space. The company is dedicated to serving highly innovative companies in the life sciences, diagnostics, drug-device, and combination product industries. Aluris is a full-service, cost-effective partner, providing complete solutions across technical transfer, formulation, filling, lyophilization, assembly, and final kitting of reagents, consumables, and combination products. Aluris provides quality and regulatory expertise to assure the highest in quality manufacturing and supply chain excellence.

**Position Overview**

The Director of Quality Assurance (QA) is responsible for leading and managing the company’s quality assurance and regulatory compliance programs. This role ensures that all quality systems align with regulatory requirements and industry best practices, maintaining compliance with ISO-13485, ISO 14971, GMP/GLP, QSR, 21 CFR 820.30, and other relevant medical device (IVD) regulations.

The Director of QA will work closely with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to develop and implement strategic quality initiatives, oversee external audits and regulatory inspections, and drive continuous improvement across the organization. This role also involves coaching and mentoring staff, managing compliance metrics, and supporting client engagements by serving as the company’s quality systems representative.

Success in this position requires strong leadership, a deep understanding of quality regulations, excellent communication skills, and the ability to build and maintain a culture of compliance and operational excellence.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and assist in performing all tasks necessary to achieve the organization's mission and help execute growth
* Work with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to formulation and execute the
* strategic vision.
* Work with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to develop and actively manage the company's quality system consistent with the culture and intent of the company
* Oversee and coordinate the quality management systems implementation.
* Accountable for maintaining a state of compliance to f CFR 21 820, 210 and 211.
* Act as the "management representative" within the quality plan.
* Will formulate and lead the management team to maintain ISO 13485 compliance.
* Will assist the leadership in implementation of the technology and process capability roadmap with specific emphasis on validation (10/OQ) and documentation support.
* Will be involved in strategic planning, evaluation, and professional development initiatives.
* Will recruit, hire and manage a motivated and highly talented staff of quality and regulatory professionals
* Provide leadership and/or support as needed throughout the organization, specifically all activities associated with bill of materials structuring, part numbering, SKU attributes, set up, training and quality management systems.
* Represent the quality systems acumen and quality systems capabilities of the company.
* Support all clients engagements as the quality system voice of the company and our capabilities
* Will actively work with the VP of Manufacturing to solve challenges in the production environment related to workflow, internal audits, material dispositions (MRP) and process changes/deviations.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Successfully served in a similar capacity in a contract manufacturing company for a highly regulated market, preferably the life science/pharmaceutical environment.
* Proven credibility as a Quality leader in the life science manufacturing environment.
* Experience and familiarity in reagent formulation, filling and finishing activities with several years of directly related accountability for quality in this form of manufacturing.
* Proven track record of exceptional performance in these FDA regulated environments with audit experience from the FDA and clients
* FDA rapport and relationships are strongly desired
* A familiarity with Lean Manufacturing cultures in a volume production facility
* Experience and proven results in driving process/technology validation efforts.
* Experience and expertise in communication exchanges with clients during tours, meetings, and audits.
* Consistently exhibited through their actions, decisions, and interactions (internally and externally), the highest standards of ethics and integrity.
* The ability to create, direct and implement corporate objectives in an environment with a high sense of urgency
* A proven capability to generate shareholder value
* Negotiation skills to maximize value in client/regulatory body discussions
* Experience building compliance and standardization of processes (building a scalable organization).

role.title: Director, Contract Manufacturing--Remote
role.description:
Empowering Physicians. Improving Lives.
 
 
Are you ready to join a team that is redefining the medical device industry?
 
 
AngioDynamics develops innovative medical technologies that empower physicians to deliver improved care and patient outcomes globally. We believe that people living with society’s most challenging diseases deserve trusted medical solutions that deliver high-quality care, wellness, and cures to live healthier, happier lives.
 
 
Invested in You
 
 
We believe world-class innovation starts with world-class people. In this role, you will be surrounded by top talent and equipped with in-depth training to maximize your potential and accelerate your career.
 
 
Total Wellness
 
 
AngioDynamics helps physicians deliver better care for their patients. We take the same approach with our own people. Our comprehensive benefits package supports your health and your loved ones, so you can do your best work.
 
 
Ready to make a lasting impact on patient care? Learn more about this role below.
 
 
JOB SUMMARY – To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.
 
 
The Director of Contract Manufacturing is responsible for developing and executing the company's contract manufacturing strategy to ensure reliable supply, consistent product quality, cost competitiveness, and operational scalability. This role oversees the selection, qualification, development, and ongoing performance management of external manufacturing partners to support current business requirements and future growth.
 
Working cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Research and Development, Finance, and Commercial teams, the Director ensures that contract manufacturing partners meet established standards for safety, quality, service, cost, compliance, and delivery.
 
 
The ideal candidate is a strategic and results-oriented leader with a strong background in external manufacturing, supplier relationship management, manufacturing operations, sustaining engineering, and continuous improvement. This individual will build strong partnerships, mitigate supply chain risks, drive operational efficiencies, and establish a scalable contract manufacturing network aligned with the company's long-term business objectives.
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
1. Contract Manufacturing Strategy
 

* Develop and implement the contract manufacturing strategy in alignment with company objectives, production requirements, and growth plans.
* Evaluate and optimize the external manufacturing network, including capacity, capabilities, geographic footprint, cost structure, and risk exposure.
* Identify, assess, and qualify new contract manufacturers to support new products, increased demand, and business expansion.
* Lead make-versus-buy assessments and provide recommendations regarding outsourcing, insourcing, and manufacturing footprint optimization.
* Develop long-term manufacturing partner strategies to ensure flexibility, scalability, and business continuity.

2. Contract Manufacturer Relationship Management
 

* Establish and maintain strategic relationships with contract manufacturing partners, serving as the primary executive-level point of contact.
* Negotiate manufacturing agreements, service-level expectations, pricing structures, capacity commitments, and performance objectives in collaboration with Procurement and Legal.
* Establish clear governance processes, business reviews, escalation protocols, and performance improvement plans.
* Drive accountability and transparency across external manufacturing partners.
* Resolve complex operational, commercial, and relationship issues to protect business performance and customer commitments.

3. Operational Performance and Supply Assurance
 

* Oversee contract manufacturer performance related to production planning, capacity utilization, on-time delivery, lead times, yield, and throughput.
* Ensure manufacturing partners maintain adequate capacity, materials availability, staffing, and production readiness to meet forecasted demand.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Planning teams to align demand forecasts, production schedules, inventory targets, and capacity plans.
* Develop contingency plans and risk mitigation strategies for supply disruptions, quality issues, capacity constraints, and geopolitical or logistical challenges.
* Lead recovery plans when external manufacturing operations fail to meet required service or production targets.

4. Quality, Compliance, and Regulatory Oversight
 

* Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to ensure contract manufacturers comply with applicable regulatory requirements, company standards, and contractual obligations.
* Ensure appropriate supplier qualification, audits, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), change control, and continuous compliance processes are in place.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring defects, deviations, customer complaints, and manufacturing nonconformances.
* Promote a culture of quality, product safety, accountability, and continuous improvement across the contract manufacturing network.
* Ensure manufacturing changes, process validations, and product transfers are appropriately controlled and documented, creating standard work for each key process and CM transaction.

5. Financial Management and Cost Optimization
 

* Develop and manage the contract manufacturing budget, including conversion costs, tooling, capital expenditures, and other external manufacturing expenses.
* Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives through process improvements, yield enhancement, productivity gains, material optimization, and commercial negotiations.
* Analyze cost drivers and manufacturing economics to improve total cost of ownership without compromising quality or service.
* Establish financial performance metrics and monitor actual results against budgets and targets.
* Support annual operating plans, long-range financial planning, and business cases for new manufacturing partnerships or capacity investments.
* Manage consignment inventory program – insuring planning alignment to forecast requirements. Establish standard reporting requirements.

6. New Product Introduction and Manufacturing Transfers
 

* Partner with Research and Development, Engineering, Quality, and Commercial teams to transition new products from development into commercial production.
* Oversee manufacturing readiness, process scale-up, technical transfer, validation, and production ramp-up activities.
* Ensure contract manufacturers have the technical capabilities, equipment, processes, and resources necessary to meet product specifications and volume requirements.
* Manage timelines, risks, and cross-functional deliverables associated with product launches, manufacturing transfers, and commercialization initiatives.

7. Performance Metrics and Continuous Improvement
 

* Establish and maintain a standardized contract manufacturer scorecard and key performance indicator (KPI) framework.
* Monitor performance against targets for quality, delivery, cost, service, productivity, and compliance.
* Lead regular operational reviews and executive business reviews with strategic manufacturing partners.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, root-cause analysis, and other operational excellence methodologies.
* Benchmark partner performance and implement best practices across the manufacturing network.

8. Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration
 

* Lead, develop, and mentor contract manufacturing, supplier management, or external operations personnel, as applicable.
* Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, and accountability across internal teams and external partners.
* Build strong cross-functional relationships to align manufacturing decisions with business needs.
* Communicate manufacturing performance, risks, opportunities, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution.
* May perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS –The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill or ability required.
 
 
Education and Experience
 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business, or a related field required.
* Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or Supply Chain Management preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, procurement, or external manufacturing.
* 5+ years of experience managing contract manufacturers, outsourced production, or strategic manufacturing partners.
* Demonstrated success developing manufacturing strategies, managing supplier performance, and improving operational and financial results.
* Experience negotiating manufacturing agreements and managing complex supplier relationships.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, product transfers, capacity expansions, or manufacturing scale-ups.
* Experience working in a multi-site, global, or complex manufacturing environment preferred.

Skills/Knowledge
 

* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, capacity management, and supply chain operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, and performance management.
* Strong financial acumen, including cost modeling, budgeting, and cost reduction.
* Knowledge of quality management systems, supplier audits, risk management, and corrective action processes.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to influence stakeholders and drive results across organizational boundaries.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, supply chain planning tools, and data-driven performance reporting.
* Willingness and ability to travel to manufacturing partner locations as required.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to effectively communication both internally and externally.
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance. instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected status.
 
 
AngioDynamics does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from third-party recruiters and/or vendors who are not expressly under current written contract.
 
 
Your ultimate salary may vary depending on your job-related skills, knowledge, and experience.

role.description:
**Director of Engineering (Food Manufacturing)**

Dessert Holdings is the leading premium dessert company in the world. We craft artisanal, scratch-made desserts at scale, combining culinary innovation with the finest real ingredients. With a rich heritage spanning seven distinctive brands, we bring unmatched expertise and tailored solutions to our Retail and Foodservice partners.

Dessert Holdings is looking for a **Director of Engineering**to be based in **Humble, TX** or ideally near one of our production facilities, who will travel as needed to sites for projects. Under the direction of the VP of Engineering & Reliability and in coordination with Corporate and Site Management teams, this individual will provide technical and professional leadership for project management and engineering across Dessert Holdings' tenFood Manufacturing Plants. This role is responsible for capital projects and for identifying, vetting, and championing new manufacturing opportunities and new or emerging technical advancements. This position requires strong personal initiative to identify opportunities, achieve engineering standardization, and implement asset and process best practices within the Dessert Holdings manufacturing facilities.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide engineering counsel and leadership for multiple facilities and internal and external project engineers.
* Manage and execute all facets of Dessert Holdings capital projects such as building expansions, and capacity expansion including brownfield and greenfield projects.
* Identify and champion cost reduction projects (capital and non-capital) through process or equipment improvements, capital automation, and robotic opportunities.
* Define technology and manufacturing capabilities to support new business and line extensions.
* Aid with developing 3/5-Year Capital Plan, including originating capital appropriation requests, developing project schedules and work teams, writing of contracts, coordinating project activities, controlling project funds, and implementing startup/training procedures as necessary.
* Write capital projects that include preparation of studies, proposals, estimates, technical reports, capital required, cash flow on approved CEA format.
* Assist in the development and implementation of new facility planning and construction. Includes developing packages, creating equipment and construction specifications, establishing and tracking project budgets, utility utilization, EPA and OSHA requirements, knowledge of GMP's, writing and justifying projects.
* Administer project bid documents and assist with rewarding contracts to outside vendors, architects, and engineers.
* Create and maintain the appropriate engineering records including equipment records and manuals, drawings and diagrams, inspection reports and legal records as required by the appropriate agencies.
* Maintain effective reporting and communication with the appropriate people both within and outside of the plant.
* Work closely with outside agencies in their respective fields, i.e., OSHA, EPA, FDA, etc., to ensure plant compliance with current regulations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering required or equivalent technical degree. Substantial applicable experience will also be considered.
* 10-15 years of engineering leadership with progressive technical and/or management experience including project management and extensive food manufacturing experience
* Ability to travel up to 75%, throughout the US (8 sites) and Canada (2 sites)
* Hands on approach to problem solving with creative solutions and ability to handle ambiguity
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Understand business implications of decisions, align work with strategic goals
* Ability to prioritize and plan work activities, set goals, timelines, and objectives
* Display original thinking, creativity and resourcefulness to generate innovative approaches and ideas
* Ability to create and drive automation opportunities including robotic manufacturing capability
* Possess leadership skills and the ability to effectively manage and communicate with engineers, construction personnel, project managers, clients and executives
* Demonstrated proficiency in Word, Excel, Gantt, Power Point, AutoCAD, and project planners
* Familiarity with controls, process, packaging, electrical, mechanical, refrigeration systems
* Knowledge of six sigma and Lean Manufacturing principles

**About Dessert Holdings**

Dssert Holdings is a collection of premium dessert companies and brands: The Original Cakerie, Lawler's Desserts, Atlanta Cheesecake Company, Steven Charles, Dianne's Fine Desserts, Kenny's Great Pies, and Willamette Valley Pie Company. Dessert Holdings is owned by Bain Capital, is headquartered in St. Paul, Minnesota, employs more than 3,500 people across ten manufacturing facilities, and is continuing its journey of rapid growth.

**EEO Statement**

Dessert Holdings and its related entities provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or any other characteristics protected by law.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
Description:

**Come Join the Toledo Tool & Die Team!**

Located close to the Michigan/Ohio border, Toledo Tool and Die has diligently served the people of both of those great states since 1940. It was a company founded on one simple principle: to do the finest work possible for our clients and to deliver on every promise we make. Today Toledo Tool & Die has four facilities in the Toledo area and one in Pioneer, Ohio.

Toledo Tool & Die is looking for a **Plant Manager** to join our team to support our continued growth.

This is a full-time position based in Toledo, Ohio. We offer competitive wages, growth opportunities, and a clean, safe work environment.

**WHAT TOLEDO TOOL & DIE CAN OFFER YOU:**

* Weekly pay
* 10 paid holidays
* 401k
* Full benefits

**WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT FOR THIS POSITION:**

* Previous experience at the plant manager level or equivalent
* Strong work ethic
* Positive attitude
* Consistent attendance
* Willingness to learn
* Safety minded

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, direction, and operational performance of an automotive manufacturing facility. This role ensures the plant meets or exceeds expectations for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee engagement while driving continuous improvement and operational excellence. The Plant Manager provides strategic leadership to all plant functions—including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Materials, HR, and EHS—ensuring alignment with organizational goals and customer requirements. This position plays a critical role in developing a high-performing culture, optimizing manufacturing processes, growing talent, and ensuring the long-term success and competitiveness of the facility.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Provide overall leadership and accountability for plant operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production across robotic assembly, and related processes.
* Establish and execute plant strategies focused on safety performance, customer satisfaction, financial targets, operational efficiency, and workforce development.
* Lead, mentor, and develop department managers, supervisors, and cross-functional teams to drive a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* Ensure compliance with safety policies, regulatory requirements, and environmental standards while actively promoting a world-class safety culture.
* Oversee adherence to IATF 16949, ISO, customer-specific requirements, and internal quality standards; partner with Quality to address issues and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor and manage plant KPIs including OEE, scrap, uptime, throughput, labor efficiency, and cost performance; ensure action plans are in place to address underperformance.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering to ensure equipment reliability, effective PM programs, and timely response to downtime or tooling issues.
* Oversee Materials/Logistics operations including inventory accuracy, material flow, scheduling, shipping, and customer delivery performance.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives, waste elimination efforts, standardized work implementation, and continuous improvement projects throughout the facility.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and visual factory standards across all production areas.
* Develop and manage annual plant budgets, capital expenditures, and long-term investment strategies.
* Collaborate with corporate leadership on production planning, capacity analysis, new program launches, engineering changes, and customer development initiatives.
* Ensure organizational compliance with HR, labor, ethics, and employment practices, including respect for human rights, non-discriminatory treatment, proper working hours, and wage law compliance.
* Build a positive employee relations environment through strong communication, coaching, and recognition; address workforce concerns and support effective engagement strategies.
* Lead regular plant meetings to ensure alignment, transparency, and effective communication across all levels of the organization.
* Represent the facility with customers, suppliers, auditors, and corporate partners.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all environmental practices are in line with job scope / position. Examples include but not limited to: proper waste disposal practices, reporting of spills, non-compliance to permit, and addressing any improper practices.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all human resources, ethics, and labor policies and practices are carried out in accordance with company policy and as in line with the scope of the position. role.title: Director of Quality Food Safety Business Partner
role.description:
At WK Kellogg Co, we exist to create joy and connection to inspire Gr-r-reat days. We believe that doing good is always good for business and we have stood for this since Kellogg Company was founded more than 120 years ago. We are passionate about doing our part to make nutritious foods, create social connectivity and respect natural resources. Together, these actions create positive progress for people and the planet – today and for years to come. We have big plans for how we are going to accomplish this, and we would love for you to join us in this effort.
 
 
The Director of Quality Food Safety (QFS) Business Partner – External Plant Network provides active leadership and sets priorities for quality, food safety and sanitation programs for the WK Kellogg Co RTEC External Network. Directs and coordinates plant quality, food safety, and sanitation personnel that enable the effective execution of innovation, policies, and standards through the delivery of tools, technical competency and capability building across all External Network plants, Co-Mans Co-Packers. Enables delivery of Business growth plans.
 
 
Ensures the investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective actions for serious and escalated issues. Responsible for functional development of direct reports.
 
 
Is a member of WK Kellogg Co QFS Leadership team.
 
 
**Dimensions:** 

* Manages travel budget
* Manages 4 Direct reports
* Ensures KIWS (Kellogg Integrated Work Systems) as the way of working
* Ensures robust capability building to enable effective coaching and development with RTEC External Network plants
* Balances plant assignment workloads and prioritizing teams to assist in plant problem solving

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
 
 

* Provides support to establish and effectively implement the Kellogg Integrated Work System (KIWS) and works effectively to ensure alignment of standards and approach. Responsible for building essential quality management skills, experience, and leadership both within assigned direct and indirect teams.
* Provides technical guidance and interprets application of WK Kellogg global policies to develop and implement site specific quality and food safety procedures that meet regulatory and WK Kellogg expectations.
* Manages the on-site plant support of quality innovation and quality improvement initiatives with RD leads to assure adherence against compliance to design standards. Supports execution of supply chain requests (SCRs) and packaging work requests (PWRs) to assure adherence against WK Kellogg Co policy and compliance with design standards.
* Make responsible decisions regarding quality, food safety and sanitation matters with WK Kellogg Co External Network plants. Operates with broad management authority, receiving minimum technical guidance and control; limited by general science-based policies and objectives of the organization. Keeps management informed of all matters of significant importance.
* Ensures sites specific RCA CAPA training and executes periodic mock recalls and inspections to ensure effectiveness of processes.
* Use influence to achieve quality objectives in manufacturing and non-manufacturing functions. Extensive use of quality reviews, conference calls, plant visits, management updates, and quality metric reporting to communicate status and progress against objectives.
* Select, train, develop, direct, and motivate an effective staff. Promotes diversity programs, recognition, and administers the Talent Management process to include the PDP process for performance evaluations and individual development plans including significant input for the plant QFS Managers.

**Work Environment:** 

* Must be accessible 24 X 7, including holidays and weekends to handle RTEC issues and plant operational needs.
* High level of travel required.
* Incumbent must be able to deal with stress and make sound decisions quickly, and at times with incomplete information.
* Must be able to manage large volumes of information and determine business relevant issues.
* Must be able to work and understand the environment dynamics of Corporate Headquarters, manufacturing, broader supply chain and regulatory environment.

 
REQUIRED EDUCATION EXPERIENCE
 
 

* This position requires strong leadership and managerial skills, excellent communication skills, and the ability to operate across a large organization and many functional areas.
* A broad technical background combined with Kellogg product and process knowledge is required.
* This position requires a degree in food science, engineering or equivalent and a minimum of 8-10 years of experience.
* The incumbent must have strong people, project, problem solving and influencing skills and the ability to manage multiple people, programs and projects and must work well in stressful situations.

**Salary Range:** $167,200 - $209,000
 
 
Salary pay ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, certifications, qualifications, relevant education or training, and local market conditions.
 
At WK Kellogg Co, our success depends on our most vital asset — our people. That’s why we’re committed to providing you with benefits and programs that support your Total Health and your journey to be and feel your best — physically, financially, emotionally, and socially.
 
Although subject to change, the below are the benefits currently offered in association with this position:
 
 

* Incentive Plan bonus eligibility
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Savings and Investment Plan with Company match and contribution
* Paid Time Off (includes paid sick time)
* 11 Paid Holidays
* Life Insurance, AD and D Insurance and STD/LTD
* Tuition reimbursement, adoption assistance for eligible employees
* Employee recognition program

The above offerings are subject to the terms of WKKC policies, which will control in the event of a conflict with the above descriptions.
 
Our comprehensive and competitive benefits not only deliver value to you and your family, but also offer choice to meet your unique needs and knowledge to empower confident decision-making.
 
ABOUT WK KELLOGG CO
 
At WK Kellogg Co, we bring our best to everyone, every day through our trusted foods and brands. Our journey began in 1894, when our founder W.K. Kellogg reimagined the future of food with the creation of Corn Flakes, changing breakfast forever. Since then, we have embraced the same spirit of innovation and entrepreneurship in everything we do, channeling our founder’s passion and commitment to creating high quality and delicious products while fostering communities. Our iconic brand portfolio includesFrosted Flakes, Rice Krispies, Froot Loops, Kashi,Special K, Raisin Bran,Frosted Mini Wheats, andBear Naked. With a presence in the majority of households across North America, our brands play a key role in enhancing the lives of millions of consumers every day, promoting a strong sense of physical, emotional, and societal wellbeing. Our beloved brand characters, including Tony the Tiger and Toucan Sam, represent our deep connections with the consumers and communities we serve. For more information, visitwww.wkkellogg.com.
 
If we can help you with a reasonable accommodation throughout the application or hiring process, please emailTalentAssist@wkkellogg.com
 
 
THE FINER PRINT
 
 
The ability to work a full shift, come to work on time, work overtime as needed and the ability to work according to the necessary schedule to meet job requirements with or without reasonable accommodation is an essential function of this position.

role.title: Senior Manager, Quality Systems
role.description:
**About Site**
--------------

Catalent’s Greendale, Indiana site is a key part of the company’s Wellness business, serving as one of North America’s primary gummy development and manufacturing centers. The site specializes in the formulation and production of traditional gelatin gummies and 100% plant‑based pectin gummies for nutritional supplements and nutraceutical applications, supporting a wide range of consumer health products. With strong in‑house R&D, quality laboratories, and flexible manufacturing and packaging capabilities, the Greendale operation partners closely with customers to develop innovative, high‑quality, and consumer‑friendly gummy delivery formats across a variety of flavors, shapes, and functional ingredients, all produced under rigorous quality and food‑safety standards.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We have an opportunity for a Senior Manager, Quality Systems to join our team and lead the Quality and Compliance functions at the Catalent Greendale site. This role oversees a team of Quality Assurance Supervisors and Specialists responsible for operational quality, product sampling, testing, and release. The position ensures compliance with industry standards and regulations while driving continuous improvement across the Quality organization. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross‑functional teams to maintain product integrity and ensure the consistent delivery of high‑quality products to our customers.

Shift: Monday through Friday, 8:00AM - 5:00PM 
Location: Greendale, IN 
100% Onsite

**The Role**
------------

* Oversee Quality and Compliance functions related to dietary supplement manufacturing at the Catalent Greendale site.
* Lead a team of Quality Assurance Supervisors and Specialists responsible for operational quality, product sampling, testing, and product release.
* Review and approve manufacturing and packaging change controls, product formulations, label changes, deviations, corrective and preventive action plans, and customer complaints.
* Ensure compliance with FDA, NSF, and SQF requirements for product manufacturing and participate in internal and external audits.
* Develop and maintain quality and compliance policies, procedures, and guidelines.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to product quality and oversee root cause analyses and corrective actions.
* Lead the Food Safety Team and ensure compliance with 21 CFR 110 and 117, HACCP Food Safety, and Food Defense Plans.
* Monitor the sanitary state of the facility and equipment to ensure cross‑contamination control.
* Collaborate with Operations to assess the effectiveness of sanitation programs and ensure compliance with food safety guidelines.
* Maintain a feedback loop with Customer Service to address quality issues affecting product release.
* Oversee training programs to educate staff on quality standards and compliance requirements.
* Establish and track key performance indicators to measure quality and compliance performance.
* Collaborate with Product Development, Technical Operations, and Supply Chain teams to integrate quality into all production processes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
* Communicate effectively with regulatory agencies, external auditors, and internal stakeholders on quality and compliance matters.
* Oversee investigations, environmental monitoring, and critical control point incidents impacting product release.
* Support site management in enforcing current Good Manufacturing Practices and mentoring staff in compliance.
* Facilitate internal assessments, compliance meetings, and training sessions.

**The Candidate**
-----------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in science or related field (Chemistry, Microbiology, or Biology) and at least five years of pharmaceutical and dietary supplement quality experience.
* Minimum of seven years of related experience, including three to four years in a supervisory or management role.
* Experience in current Good Manufacturing Practice compliance and working in a quality role within the pharmaceutical or dietary supplement manufacturing industry.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure to meet deadlines. The individual may be required to sit, stand, walk regularly, and occasionally lift up to 15 pounds; no lifting greater than 44.09 pounds without assistance. Must be accessible to the manufacturing floor and office staff and use required office equipment. Specific vision requirements include reading written documents and frequent use of a computer monitor.
* Demonstrable leadership experience at Catalent (including but not limited to participation in Catalent‑sponsored leadership programs such as NGGL, GOLD, LEAD Now, GM Excellence, and GROW) may be considered in place of external experience.

### **Preferred Skills & Background**

* Experience with investigation writing, including root cause analysis and report preparation for annual product reviews.
* Familiarity with regulations 21 CFR 111, 21 CFR 117, 21 CFR 211, GFSI, HACCP, Preventive Controls Qualified Individual, SQF, NSF, and UL certifications.
* Experience with electronic systems such as JDE, TrackWise, Electronic Document Management System, Learning Management System, Quality Management System, Veeva, Compliance Wire, and Stability Programs.
* Experience communicating with FDA inspectors or other regulatory agents and handling FDA 483 responses.
* Experience using artificial intelligence tools to improve quality systems.

**Why You Should Join Catalent**
--------------------------------

* Positive and fast‑paced working environment focusing on continually improving processes to remain innovative and dynamic.
* Competitive Paid Time Off plus eight paid holidays.
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day one of employment.
* Tuition Reimbursement – support to complete or earn a new degree.
* Site‑based Employee Engagement activities such as End‑of‑Summer and NFL kickoff celebrations, March Madness tournament, Summer Food Truck Fridays, Veterans Appreciation Lunch, Homemade Chili Cook‑off, Salsa Competition, Ice Cream Sundae Bar, and more.
* Employee Resource Groups focusing on Diversity and Inclusion.
* Environmentally friendly, community engagement green initiatives.
* Defined career path and annual performance review process with potential for career growth on an expanding team.
* WellHub program promoting overall physical and mental wellness.
* Perkspot offering exclusive discounts from over 900 merchants across various categories.

**Catalent offers rewarding opportunities to further your career!** Join the global drug development and delivery leader and help us bring over 7,000 life-saving and life-enhancing products to patients around the world. Catalent is an exciting and growing international company where employees work directly with pharma, biopharma and consumer health companies of all sizes to advance new medicines from early development to clinical trials and to the market. Catalent produces more than 70 billion doses per year, and each one will be used by someone who is counting on us. Join us in making a difference.

role.title: Senior Director, Technical Product Management — AI Quality & Evaluation
role.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Product

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters** 
 
Help build the next generation of Agentforce. We’re an entrepreneurial incubation team within Salesforce, combining the pace and ownership of a startup with access to enterprise customers and Salesforce’s distribution. We’re looking for a technical product leader with deep AI expertise who wants to turn frontier capabilities into products customers can rely on.
 
 
Our team works closely with AI researchers, applied scientists, and engineers, uses coding agents extensively, and builds and experiments outside the core platform to iterate quickly. You’ll shape product strategy for AI quality and evaluation, establish how we measure progress, and personally lead a customer quality workstream and a focused feature from early learning through delivery.
 
 
This is a hands-on individual contributor leadership role, with an IC focus expected through 2027. You’ll lead through product ownership, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence while coaching colleagues, including junior designers and technical program managers. People-management responsibilities may develop as the product and team grow. You should enjoy inspecting traces and data, challenging evaluation results, prototyping with coding agents, and working directly with customers. Engineering partners own technical architecture and production implementation.
 
 
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Set a coherent product strategy and roadmap for AI quality and evaluation, connecting customer needs, technical opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish shared quality definitions, evaluation requirements, coverage priorities, and release criteria with research, engineering, and product partners.
* Make explicit investment tradeoffs across customer quality improvements, evaluation capabilities, and product features; align teams on priorities and decision ownership.
* Personally lead customer investigations and experiments. For example, investigate why an agent gives an incorrect answer or fails a tool-driven workflow, define the expected behavior, and partner with researchers and engineers to test a change and validate its customer impact.
* Build an operating approach that connects customer feedback, evaluation evidence, experiments, releases, and learning across teams.
* Partner with researchers, applied scientists, and engineers to design credible evaluations. Apply AI/ML fundamentals such as training/test separation, overfitting, representative coverage, and independent validation to assess non-deterministic model behavior and grader reliability.
* Lead delivery of capabilities that help customers understand and improve AI performance. For example, prototype an experience that turns a failed agent interaction into an evaluation case, makes the quality gap clear, and helps a customer verify whether a proposed change works.
* Coach product partners, junior designers, and technical program managers in problem framing, experimentation, and delivery; raise the quality of decisions through mentorship and practical example.
Bring verified competitive insight into strategy and communicate differentiation, limitations, and investment choices clearly to customers and senior stakeholders. 

**Minimum Requirements**

* A record of building AI/ML products and delivering measurable customer outcomes, with increasing ownership, scope, and impact.
* Deep hands-on experience building AI agents and evaluation capabilities in close partnership with AI researchers, applied scientists, or AI engineers. One to two years of substantive generative AI experience can be sufficient when supported by strong AI/ML fundamentals and demonstrated impact.
* Strong applied AI/ML judgment across model behavior, prompting, retrieval, agent/tool workflows, and the tradeoffs among model, data, system, and product improvements.
* Current hands-on ability to inspect data and traces, prototype with coding agents, and reason about experiments, overfitting, training/test splits, edge cases, and uncertainty. You can define what good looks like for a non-deterministic system and challenge conclusions with technical partners.
* Principled, flexible thinking: frame the underlying customer problem, test assumptions, and change direction when evidence warrants it. You can explain when lessons from a previous product apply and when the context demands a different approach.
* Experience establishing shared standards and resolving cross-team disagreements while preserving clear accountability and delivery momentum.

role.description:
**Head of Operations (HVAC)**

$110,000-$150,000 annually, plus performance bonuses

Houma, LA | Full-Time

As One Way AC and Electrical continues its rapid growth in residential and commercial HVAC, we're seeking an experienced **Head of Operations** to lead our expanding team, drive operational excellence, develop future leaders, and play a pivotal role in shaping the company's long-term success while building a rewarding career alongside us.

**Your Role:**

* Lead and inspire our service, installation, and operational teams.
* Build a culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and professional development.
* Create scalable processes that support company growth.
* Improve operational efficiency while maintaining exceptional customer experiences.
* Partner directly with ownership on strategic planning and future business initiatives.
* Help identify and develop future leaders within the organization.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Competitive base salary of $110,000-$150,000, based on experience.
* Performance bonuses and commission opportunities.
* Company-paid medical insurance covering 80% of employee premiums.
* Optional dental and vision insurance.
* 401(k) with up to a 3% employer match.
* Six paid holidays.
* Paid vacation that increases with tenure, plus two additional PTO days.
* Optional short-term and long-term disability coverage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Direct the daily operations of residential and commercial HVAC service and installation departments.
* Mentor managers, technicians, and support staff to maximize performance and career development.
* Monitor operational metrics and use data to improve productivity, profitability, and service quality.
* Ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest workmanship standards.
* Optimize scheduling, workflow, staffing, and resource allocation.
* Manage departmental budgets, labor costs, inventory, and operational expenses.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
* Champion an outstanding customer experience while maintaining high performance expectations.

**Required Qualifications**

* At least five years of experience within an HVAC company.
* Proven success overseeing residential and commercial HVAC operations.
* Strong knowledge of HVAC service, installation, and field operations.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and retain high-performing teams.
* Experience managing KPIs, financial performance, scheduling, and operational planning.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and decision-making skills.
* Familiarity with Service Titan or comparable HVAC management software is beneficial.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Building engaged, high-performing teams that consistently deliver outstanding results.
* Creating operational systems that support sustainable growth.
* Increasing efficiency, profitability, and overall business performance.
* Developing future leaders within the organization.
* Delivering an exceptional customer experience that strengthens Oneway AC's reputation.
* Helping drive the continued growth of one of the region's fastest-growing HVAC companies.

role.description:
The Director of Operations is responsible for supporting the mission, vision and values of First Watch through all that he/she does in their role every day. The DO’s primary purpose is to develop General Managers and restaurant management teams to build and increase sales over the previous year and improve profitability, while ensuring employee and guest satisfaction, without compromising the integrity or You First culture of the concept. The Director of Operations is responsible for the success of all First Watch operations within their span of control (5-8 direct reports and 200-300 employees).

**Job Responsibilities**

* Leads operational activities for a group of First Watch Restaurants by performing the following in accordance with Company guidelines regarding management development, sales, and profitability, planning and customer and employee relations
* Trains, coaches and develops General Managers and Operations Managers, through timely performance and observation feedback and evaluations
* Follows up on training of MIT's/CAFE’s and hourly employees. Works closely with the Training General Manager to monitor progress
* Ensures development of Operations Managers within compliance of the FW management development programs
* Through effective manpower planning executes the continuous development of the management team and ensures timely and cost effective recruitment of restaurant level management and their training within First Watch
* Ensures the maintenance of a safe and harassment free workplace in all restaurants
* Takes quick and responsible action in solving problems and able to uses reason when dealing with individual or staff performance based issues to include personality conflicts
* Develops for prior approval and then meets or exceeds the area’s budget, including capital investments, General and Administrative expenses
* Promotes First Watch outside the restaurant

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent – concentration in food & beverage, business, marketing or management is preferred
* Five to seven years of progressive leadership experience in multi unit restaurant industry operations
* Proven track record of achieving results and building & maintaining successful teams
* Passion for providing excellent service and quality
* Ability to partner and build relationships while demonstrating leadership and integrity and promoting team success
* Extensive knowledge of the principles, procedures, and best practices in the industry
* Ability to work well under pressure in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel frequently within assigned market

role.description:
**Role Overview:** The primary purpose of the job is to be responsible and accountable for the successful, ongoing development, refinement, implementation, measurement, ongoing quality improvement and effectiveness of Long Term Services & Support (LTSS).

**Work Arrangement:**

* Remote - This posiiton is fully remote, and the Associate must be in Pennsylvania (PA)
* Travel to state & leadership meeting as needed.
* Reliable high‑speed internet required (minimum 50 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload)
* Associates residing in states where reimbursement is required by contract, law, or regulation may submit eligible expenses for reimbursement

**Responsibilities:**

* Overseeing quality management for Long Term Services and Supports (LTSS) in PA
* Accountable for ongoing maintenance of the Plan’s compliance with state regulations and National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA)/Utilization Review Accreditation Commission (URAC) and other appropriate standards for activities related to Quality, Care Management and Utilization Management.
* This includes credentialing/re-credentialing activity, delegation oversight, quality of care investigations as well as the corresponding inter- and intra-departmental coordination, communication, and education.
* Oversight and responsibility for the Plan’s, Line of Business or Product Line’s QAPIC Committee structure and support.
* Works directly with Senior Executives to plan, organize and direct the identification, prioritization and implementation of strategic projects that improve financial, service and clinical outcomes for the Plan, LOB or Product Line.
* In coordination with Plan stakeholders, develop, implement and lead strategy to improve HEDIS outcomes and maximize pay for performance payout and reduce withholds and/or liquidated damages
* Provides functional support to the Network Management, Informatics, Information Solutions, Care Coordination, Utilization Management, and Public Affairs departments to integrate Quality Management initiatives and goals with organizational programs.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* An active unrestricted licensed Registered Nurse (RN) in PA or healthcare quality certification such as American Board of Quality Assurance and Utilization Review Physicians (ABQAURP) or Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) in accordance with state specific requirements
* 1 to 3 years of experience in Medicaid.
* 5 to 10 years of experience in a clinical setting
* 5 or more years of experience in managed care and leadership.
* Prior URAC or NCQA Accreditation experience

**Skills & Abilities:**

* Strong leadership and people-management skills, with the ability to supervise, coach, develop, and provide performance feedback to quality management staff.
* Extensive knowledge of healthcare quality assurance, quality improvement, outcomes management, and performance improvement principles and practices.
* Ability to develop and present comprehensive quality reports, analyses, recommendations, and performance findings to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple quality initiatives, priorities, deadlines, and contractual deliverables.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, leadership, providers, and external stakeholders.
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to communicate complex quality and clinical information clearly to varied audiences.
* Demonstrated problem-solving, critical-thinking, and independent decision-making skills.
* Ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and lead the development and implementation of improved clinical and administrative processes.
* Strong interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to effectively manage difficult or sensitive situations.
* Ability to collaborate across departments and build strong working relationships to support organization-wide quality improvement initiatives.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to effectively use technology for reporting, data analysis, documentation, and communication.

role.title: Director of Quality – Women’s and Children Services
role.description:
**A Brief Overview** 
The Director of Quality, Safety, Accreditation and Policy provides strategic and operational leadership for clinical 
quality, patient safety, regulatory readiness, accreditation compliance, and organizational policy management 
across a large, complex medical center. The Director establishes priorities, ensures alignment across clinical and 
operational functions, and partners with physician, nursing, operational, and administrative executives to 
advance high reliability, continuous improvement, regulatory excellence, and patient-centered care. This position 
has accountability for the design, execution, and sustained performance of quality improvement, patient safety, 
accreditation, policy governance, performance measurement, and regulatory compliance programs. The Director 
translates organizational strategy into medical center-wide priorities, evaluates performance and risk, directs 
corrective action, and provides executive leaders with recommendations needed to achieve organizational goals 
and external standards. 
What You Will Do 

* Quality and Performance Improvement
* Establish and lead the organization's quality, safety, accreditation, and policy strategy in alignment with

organizational strategy and medical center priorities. 

* Set the performance improvement agenda and direct organization-wide and departmental initiatives,

including prioritization, resource allocation, accountability, and sustainability of results. 

* Establish performance expectations and governance for key quality indicators, publicly reported

measures, regulatory metrics, and improvement commitments; intervene when performance or 
compliance is at risk. 

* Facilitate data-driven improvement efforts using Lean, Six Sigma, PDSA, and other improvement

methodologies. 

* Own the integrity, interpretation, and executive communication of quality dashboards, scorecards, and

performance reporting, including recommendations for action and escalation. 

* Partner with physician and nursing leaders to improve clinical outcomes, reliability, equity, and patient

experience. 

* Exercise decision-making authority within the assigned portfolio and escalate material quality, safety,

regulatory, or accreditation risks to executive leadership and appropriate governance bodies. 

* Define accountability structures for leaders responsible for performance improvement plans and verify

that corrective actions produce sustained results. 

* Patient Safety
* Provide leadership for the patient safety program and establish expectations for a culture of safety, high

reliability, transparency, learning, and accountability 

* Direct governance for event reporting, root cause analyses, apparent cause analyses, and corrective

action plans; ensure timely escalation, leadership accountability, and validation that risk-reduction 
actions are effective and sustained. 

* In partnership with Risk and clinical loss control, monitor serious safety events, near misses, and highreliability

metrics. 

* Collaborate with risk management, infection prevention, and operational leaders on safety priorities.
* Integrate patient safety, infection prevention, clinical risk, quality improvement, and regulatory priorities

to reduce duplication, close gaps, and promote consistent practices across care settings. 

* Support implementation of evidence-based practices to reduce preventable harm.
* Accreditation and Regulatory Compliance
* Provide oversight of Joint Commission, DNV, CMS, state, and specialty accreditation readiness,

partnering with the designated accreditation leader who directs day-to-day readiness activities to include 
establishing priorities, assigning corrective actions, and escalating unresolved compliance risks. 

* Oversee organizational responses to survey findings and regulatory deficiencies, including corrective

action governance, evidence submission, validation of sustained compliance, and executive escalation; 
monitor regulatory changes and communicate implications to leadership; and partner with operational 
leaders to address gaps and sustain compliance. 

* Policy Management and Governance
* Lead policy governance and document control processes including standards for development, approval,

publication, review, exception management, and retirement. 

* Ensure policies remain current, evidence-based, and aligned with regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate policy review cycles and approvals with clinical, operational, legal, compliance, and executive

stakeholders.

Evaluate policy compliance trends and identify improvement opportunities. 

* Resolve or escalate cross-functional policy conflicts and ensure accountable leaders address material

gaps in policy implementation or adherence. 

* Maintain oversight of organizational policy standards and publication processes. Consistent with UH

policy governance structures, accreditation, compliance, legal, quality, and operational leaders 
collaborate to ensure policy adherence and regulatory alignment. 

* Academic Mission Support
* Collaborate with medical school leadership, residency and fellowship programs, and research leadership

to integrate quality, safety, and regulatory expectations into organizational programs. 

* Support quality and safety education for medical students, residents, fellows, and faculty.
* Leadership and Operations
* Establish departmental goals, operating plans, budgets, staffing models, and resource priorities; monitor

financial and operational performance and adjust plans as organizational needs change. 

* Build leadership capability and succession plans for quality, safety, accreditation, regulatory, policy, and

performance improvement professionals; hold direct reports accountable for measurable outcomes. 

* Serve as the quality and safety advisor to executive, physician, nursing, and operational leadership,

providing independent evaluation of performance, risk, regulatory exposure, and improvement priorities. 

* Present quality, safety, accreditation, regulatory, and policy performance to governing boards, executive

committees, and medical staff leadership; recommend decisions, investments, and corrective actions. 

* Chair or lead multidisciplinary governance committees focused on quality, accreditation, safety,

regulatory compliance, and policy, with authority to establish agendas, assign accountability, and 
escalate unresolved issues. 

* Negotiate priorities and resource needs across competing operational demands while protecting

regulatory compliance, patient safety, and organizational performance. 

* Represent the medical center in organization-wide councils and, as assigned, with external regulators,

accrediting organizations, professional associations, and community partners.

**Additional Responsibilities** 

* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Complies with all policies and standards.
* For specific duties and responsibilities, refer to documentation provided by the department during

orientation. 

* Must abide by all requirements to safely and securely maintain Protected Health Information (PHI) for

our patients. Annual training, the UH Code of Conduct and UH policies and procedures are in place to 
address appropriate use of PHI in the workplace.

**Education Qualifications** 

* Bachelor's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, or

related field (Required) 

* Master's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, or related

field Preferred (Preferred)

**Experience Qualifications** 

* 8+ years of experience in healthcare quality, patient safety, accreditation, regulatory, and clinical

leadership experience with several years in people management capacity[ (Required) 

* Experience within an academic medical center, integrated delivery system, or large healthcare

organization. (Required) 
• • Experience with Joint Commission/DNV survey leadership. • Experience overseeing policy governance. 

* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior and executive leaders, managing

organizational change, and sustaining measurable results across complex operations. • Experience 
presenting to governing boards, executive committees, medical staff leadership, or comparable senior 
governance groups. • Experience managing budgets, staffing plans, and resource allocation for a 
complex function or department. (Preferred

**Licenses and Certifications** 
• • Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) • Certified Professional in Patient Safety (CPPS) • 
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent • Healthcare accreditation or regulatory certification 
(Preferred)

**Physical Demands**

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Who We Are** 
Founded in 1991 and located in Knox, Pennsylvania, Eden Millwork manufactures pre-finished millwork products, including mouldings, pre-hung doors, and specialty items for the manufactured housing industry. Today, Eden is part of the Metrie family, a leading North American millwork manufacturer and distributor.

With a dedicated team of approximately 35 employees, Eden combines the collaboration and impact of a close-knit operation with the opportunities of the broader Metrie organization. We are committed to quality, customer service, safety, continuous improvement, and a workplace where our people can grow.

**Why should you work for Metrie?** 
With us, you’re more than just a number. We work hard to create a home for our Metrie family where you are empowered to be your best every day. Your contributions matter to us! We take pride in our culture of learning, ownership, and one team, and are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. Watch this video to see why our employees feel like they truly belong here: **Feels like a Family – YouTube**

**The role** 
We are looking for a hands-on manufacturing leader to join Eden Millwork as Plant Manager. This is an opportunity for a people-focused leader who enjoys being close to the operation, developing an engaged team and fostering a safe work environment while delivering high-quality products for our customers.

Reporting to the Director of Eden, the Plant Manager is accountable for day-to-day plant performance, including safety, production, quality, financial results, maintenance, continuous improvement and on-time customer delivery.

**Location** 
This is an on-site role based at Eden Millwork in Knox, Pennsylvania.

**What You'll Do**

As Plant Manager, you will lead the Eden operation and translate business priorities into clear plans, expectations, and measurable results. You will maintain a strong presence on the production floor, build accountability across the team, and partner closely with Metrie leaders and support functions.

**You will**

* Lead day-to-day plant operations, aligning production, scheduling, maintenance, staffing, materials, and resources to achieve safety, quality, cost, and delivery objectives.
* Champion a proactive safety culture through employee engagement, safe work practices, hazard identification, training, and timely follow-up on incidents and corrective actions.
* Establish clear expectations for quality and consistent workmanship across pre-finished mouldings, pre-hung doors, and specialty millwork products.
* Monitor plant performance and take timely action to improve productivity, throughput, quality, cost, and customer service.
* Manage plant financial performance to meet or exceed budget targets, control costs and resource utilization, and drive Lean/Kaizen initiatives to improve efficiency and track savings.
* Plan production, labour, materials, and equipment needs to keep the operation running effectively and support reliable, on-time customer delivery.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance, capital projects, and equipment improvement priorities to minimize downtime and support production readiness.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Eden team, building ownership, collaboration, accountability, and capability across the operation.
* Partner closely with Sales to understand customer needs, demand forecasts and upcoming opportunities, aligning production plans and capacity with business priorities and delivery commitments.
* Partner with People & Culture on workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, performance management, employee relations, and employee development.
* Lead practical continuous improvement initiatives that improve workflow, productivity, quality, and cost performance.
* Build effective relationships with customers and suppliers and respond quickly to operational, material, scheduling, or service issues.
* Provide clear reporting on plant financials and key operating indicators, including variances, corrective actions, and improvement results.
* Collaborate with other Metrie teams to share best practices and support broader manufacturing and business priorities.

**Who You Are**

You are a practical and experienced manufacturing leader who enjoys being close to the operation and working alongside the team. You are comfortable in a hands-on manufacturing environment where quality and customer commitments matter and leaders are willing to roll up their sleeves. You set clear expectations, follow through on commitments, and build trust through consistent leadership.

**You bring:**

* A minimum of five years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, with a strong track record of leading, coaching and developing teams.
* Experience driving manufacturing performance across safety, quality, production, cost and customer delivery.

role.title: Director of Operations (Mobile Devices)
role.description:
We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Director of Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) Operations to lead and optimize our end-to-end CPO operations. This executive leadership role is responsible for driving operational excellence, quality, profitability, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across multiple functions, including demand planning, production and repair operations, new product introduction, customer implementations, service delivery, and product lifecycle management. The ideal candidate is a proven operations leader with experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, or refurbishment environments. This individual will leverage Lean Six Sigma methodologies, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional leadership to deliver scalable processes, exceptional customer outcomes, and sustained business growth.

This is an onsite role in our Lewisville TX facility, with occasional travel (~10%).

**What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?**

* Lead all aspects of CPO operations, ensuring high levels of quality, service, productivity, and profitability
* Develop and execute short- and long-term operational strategies aligned with business objectives
* Establish policies, procedures, and performance standards that drive operational excellence and accountability
* Oversee demand planning, operations planning and control, production processes, repair operations, parts reclamation, customer implementations, system support, and customer service functions
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma principles and best practices
* Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance programs that improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance customer satisfaction
* Partner with Product Development and Engineering teams to support new product introductions and operational readiness
* Identify opportunities to optimize workflows, improve scalability, and enhance operational performance
* Own operational financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and profitability analysis
* Evaluate business opportunities and operational investments through financial modeling and data-driven analysis
* Monitor key performance indicators and implement corrective actions to achieve business goals
* Recruit, develop, coach, and lead high-performing teams
* Establish performance expectations, succession planning, and employee development strategies
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Serve as the primary operational partner for internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Resolve operational, product, system, and customer-related issues while maintaining strong client relationships
* Collaborate across departments to successfully deliver strategic initiatives and operational improvements
* Present recommendations, business cases, and operational updates to leadership teams and executive audiences
* Support the development, launch, and operational integration of new products and services
* Drive ongoing product profitability, compliance, and lifecycle performance
* Partner with key stakeholders to identify and implement innovative solutions that support business growth

**What are the requirements needed for this position?**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* 6+ years of progressive leadership experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, refurbishment, or operations environments
* Strong experience in demand planning, production planning, procurement, materials management, and new product introduction
* Proven success leading process improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies
* Advanced analytical and financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and operational performance management
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, trend analysis, reporting, and data visualization
* Experience with project management, resource planning, and systems implementation
* Exceptional leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
* Strong problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach to decision-making

**What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?**

* Experience using AI tools and automation technologies to improve business processes and operational efficiency
* Background in technical, mechanical, electronics repair, refurbishment, or manufacturing environments
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher
* Experience working within ISO and OSHA-regulated environments
* Experience with Oracle ERP systems
* Experience supporting wireless or consumer electronics products

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases.
