role.title: Director of Manufacturing Operations
role.description:
Airlite Plastics is a premier, privately held, family-owned manufacturer headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. Our family style and personal culture is what makes Airlite an amazing place to grow and build a successful career. Airlite’s company values of unquestionable integrity and respect and appreciation for each other are at the core of our success! These values set a strong foundation to build on where we can ‘wow’ our customers with innovative products and sustainable solutions and continuously improve our processes and efficiencies.

 

Our product lines include rigid plastic containers and lids for food packaging and cosmetics, dry powder scoops, plastic drink cups, shipping containers, industrial strength insulated concrete forms (ICF) and sustainable permeable paving systems. As pioneers in our industry, focused on sustainable solutions, we strive to provide our customers with top-notch service and quality, which aligns with our award-winning products.

 

As Airlite continues to grow and expand, we are excited to add new roles across our organization to support increasing customer demand and future innovation. This is an exciting time to join our team and be part of a company investing in people, technology, and long-term success.

 

**How would you contribute?**

This role is a contributing member of our team located in Nazareth, PA. As a Director of Operations you are a key to continued growth and success of Airlite. The Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for manufacturing operations across assigned Airlite Locations. This role is responsible for Production, Maintenance, and Engineering and ensures operational strategies, resources, and priorities are aligned with business objectives.

This role will drive operational excellence through strong leadership, development of site leadership teams, continuous improvement, effective use of performance metrics, and disciplined execution. A key focus of this position is building leadership capability throughout the organization by coaching and developing managers and supervisors as the operations continue to grow and evolve. The Director will balance consistent operational expectations across locations while recognizing the unique needs and autonomy of each facility.

**Essential Duties:**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for Production, Maintenance, and Engineering across the Nazareth and Lakeville facilities.

* Lead, coach, and develop operational leaders, strengthening leadership capability, accountability, decision-making, and succession readiness throughout the organization.

* Establish operational priorities, goals, and KPIs and use performance data to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

* Ensure manufacturing operations consistently achieve objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, productivity, efficiency, and cost.

* Partner with site leadership to develop and execute operational plans that support business growth, capacity requirements, equipment needs, and organizational objectives.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve manufacturing processes, equipment reliability, labor effectiveness, throughput, and overall operational performance.

* Provide leadership for capital projects, equipment installations, process improvements, and other operational initiatives in partnership with Engineering and Maintenance.

* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing, and leadership needs and develop teams capable of supporting current operations and future growth.

* Promote consistency and sharing of best practices between facilities while allowing each operation to respond effectively to its specific business and manufacturing needs.

* Partner cross-functionally with Quality, Supply Chain, Safety, Human Resources, Finance, Sales, Customer Service, and other functions to resolve issues and achieve business objectives.

* Develop and manage operational budgets, forecasts, capital requirements, and resource plans in alignment with financial and strategic objectives.

* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, collaboration, employee development, continuous improvement, and operational excellence while exemplifying Airlite's Core Values and servant leadership principles.

* Other duties as assigned.

 

**Do you have what it takes?** Airlite Plastics is a versatile employer; complacency is not one of our strengths! We work hard each day to ensure that equipment efficiency and customer satisfaction never leave our line of sight. Successful candidates for the role will possess the following:

 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, Manufacturing, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including significant responsibility for manufacturing operations.
* 5+ years of experience leading managers and/or senior operational leaders.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing multiple operational functions such as Production, Maintenance, and Engineering.
* Experience leading operations across multiple facilities or business units strongly preferred.
* Experience with capital planning, operational budgeting, continuous improvement, and manufacturing performance management.
* Plastics manufacturing, injection molding, extrusion, or related manufacturing experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop managers and emerging leaders.
* Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to understand the impact of operational decisions on overall business performance.
* Ability to effectively lead across multiple facilities, balancing consistent operational expectations with the unique needs of each location.
* Capability to solve complex problems, utilizing strong critical thinking and decision-making skills
* Superior organizational skills and the ability to assemble resources needed to orchestrate multiple projects/activities and accomplish goals
* Model a collaborative leadership style with the ability to build partnerships and influence others into action
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills
* Outstanding presentation and facilitation skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills and consultative approach; tactful in dealing with people at all levels
* Strong sense of urgency, self-motivated and positive
* Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations
* Ability to actively lead change initiatives
* Display highest ethical standards
* Maintain the utmost level of confidentiality in dealing with sensitive information
* Detail oriented, with the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; stand; walk; use hand dexterity to operate office equipment including computer keyboards; reach with hands and arms; and talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be exposed to moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the office work environment is typically quiet; when visiting the production floor, the noise level may be loud.

 

**Our Core Values Drive Us!**

 

* Do you conduct yourself with unquestionable integrity?

* Do you demonstrate respect and appreciation for those around you?

* Are you innovative and strive to challenge the status quo?

* Do you strive for continuous improvement and to deliver the “wow” factor?

* Do you care about environmentally sustainable solutions?

* Do you take meaning and pride in a job well done?

 

**What’s in it for you?** ***As a Full-Time employee, you will be eligible for the following benefits:***

 

* Health, dental and vision insurance

* Company paid life insurance

* Company paid short term disability

* Generous 401k match

* Generous Time Off

* Annual company activities

role.title: Director of Manufacturing Operations
role.description:
Description:

**Lead Strategy. Drive Performance. Shape the Future.**

KSP Group, Inc/Jensen Metal Products is seeking a hands-on manufacturing leader to drive operational excellence, strengthen accountability, improve execution, and build scalable operating systems across our manufacturing businesses. This is not a corporate executive role designed to lead from a conference room.

We are looking for a proven change agent who is equally comfortable reviewing financial results, leading daily operational reviews, solving production challenges on the shop floor, and developing frontline leaders.

This is a multi-site position, initially focused on Jensen Metal Products and Jensen Powder Finishers. The successful candidate will build the structure, discipline, and performance culture needed to support long-term growth across KSP Group.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in fabrication and manufacturing environments, a strong operational and financial mindset, and a proven ability to lead teams through growth and transformation.

**About KSP Group**

KSP Group is a family-owned organization with a diverse portfolio of manufacturing and consumer product companies

* **Jensen Metal Products** – Custom metal fabrication, welding, machining, laser cutting, engineering and contract manufacturing solutions (Racine, WI)
* **Jensen Powder Finishers** – Advanced powder coating and finishing services (Sturtevant, WI)
* **Jensen Castings** – Manufacturer of premium GFRC concrete fire features (Richland Center, WI)
* **Real Flame** – A leading designer and manufacturer of fireplaces, fire tables, and outdoor living products sold through major retailers across North America (Union Grove, WI)

Together, our companies are built on innovation, craftsmanship, customer partnerships, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a visible impact, influence company strategy, and help shape the future of multiple growing businesses.

**What You'll Do**

Executive Strategic & Business Leadership

* Lead the development and execution of operational strategies that support long-term business objectives and growth initiatives
* Partner with executive leadership to establish priorities, allocate resources, and drive enterprise-wide operational improvements
* Lead plant leadership teams in defining strategic direction, performance goals, and key operational initiatives
* Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, capacity expansion, and operational scalability

Financial & Operational Performance

* Own operational performance and P&L results across assigned manufacturing operations
* Develop departmental budgets, monitor spending, and ensure responsible management of operational resources
* Analyze manufacturing costs, labor efficiency, productivity metrics, and operating expenses to drive profitability
* Report on operational performance and improvement initiatives to executive leadership

Manufacturing Operations & Continuous Improvement

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives across fabrication, welding, machining, powder coating, assembly, engineering, and support functions
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, root cause problem solving, and waste reduction efforts
* Improve throughput, quality, safety, delivery performance, and overall operational efficiency
* Lead cross-functional projects focused on sustainable operational gains and measurable business results

Leadership & Culture

* Build, coach, and develop high-performing operational leadership teams
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Promote employee engagement while creating a safe, quality-focused work environment

Requirements:

**What We're Looking For**

* Demonstrated success leading directly from the manufacturing floor, including personal involvement in:
* Production planning and scheduling
* Labor performance management
* Quality improvement initiatives
* Corrective action processes
* Maintenance and equipment planning
* Capital investment justification
* Safety and operational accountability
* Frontline leadership development
* Proven track record of transforming entrepreneurial manufacturing organizations into process-driven, scalable operations through both strategic leadership and active engagement with frontline teams
* Ability to establish accountability without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
* Strong understanding of fabrication, welding, machining, finishing, assembly, materials management, and manufacturing cost drivers

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, or related field, preferred
* Multi-site manufacturing leadership experience
* Lean Six Sigma certification
* Experience within both contract manufacturing and consumer products environments
* ERP/MRP system experience

**Travel Requirements**

* Regular travel between KSP Group facilities, including Jensen Metal Products, Jensen Powder Finishers, Jensen Castings, and Real Flame locations
* Frequent presence on manufacturing floors to support leadership teams, operational reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Approximately 25-50% travel, primarily within Wisconsin and company operating locations
* Occasional overnight travel for customer visits, supplier meetings, strategic initiatives, and industry events

**About Us**

Jensen Metal Products is a metal fabrication business with over 100 years of experience serving the Midwest and surrounding regions with custom, quality sheet metal parts and assemblies. With a broad range of manufacturing capabilities, we produce a diverse portfolio of products, including our own line of fireplaces, which has been in production since 1970. We serve many types of businesses including the agricultural, retail, energy and healthcare fields. From engineering to packaging, our goal is to be a one-stop shop that exceeds our customers’ expectations for quality, delivery, great customer service and cost. At Jensen Metal Products we pride ourselves on having strong, long-lasting relationships with our employees and customers. We welcome you to join our team!

**Benefits**

* Competitive base salary plus profit sharing
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with multiple plan options (HDHP and copay), FSA benefits, and the ability to use your existing HSA
* Company-funded medical deductible reimbursement — up to $1,000 (individual) / $2,000 (family)
* 401(k) with company match up to 4%
* Life and disability insurance and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Annual Safety PPE Reimbursement
* A collaborative, team-oriented environment with direct access to leadership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a growing organization
* Company-sponsored team events and outings that foster connection and celebrate team success

**Work Authorization**

Jensen Metal Products does not sponsor employment visas now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

**Recruiting Agencies**

Jensen Metal Products does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, recruiting firms, or search agencies. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Jensen Metal Products employees or through our application process will become the property of Jensen Metal Products, and no fee will be paid if the candidate is hired.

Table 87 Frozen LLC is a national frozen pizza manufacturer and “The Home Of The Coal Oven Slice.” Born in Brooklyn NY, founder Thomas Cucco opened his first slice shop in Brooklyn Heights in 2012. The Director of Operations, Frozen is a full-time, on-site role based in Brooklyn, NY. Core responsibilities include production leadership, packaging, staffing, inventory and supply-chain optimization, logistics expertise, food-safety elevation, and full facility/equipment readiness. Our mandate is clear: take a high-growth disruptor brand’s production operation and turn it into a dominant, scalable food-manufacturing engine. Success in this role is designed to evolve into COO.

* Proven track record evolving an emerging brand into advanced, large-scale manufacturing success
* Proven blend of entrepreneurial grit and disciplined management systems

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. You'll oversee operations at advanced facilities, ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that help our customers make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. **JOB DESCRIPTION** 
 
 

Step into a leadership role, where your management skills will drive strategic risk and compliance initiatives. Embrace the opportunity to enhance your leadership capabilities and make a meaningful impact on the future of risk management and control testing. 
 
As a **Compliance and Operations Risk Test Director** in the Testing Center of Excellence, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the testing strategy across various business lines, ensuring alignment with regulatory and firm requirements. Your expertise in risk management and control testing will be instrumental in identifying and mitigating risks, thereby enhancing compliance and operational risk management. You will be expected to make independent decisions that significantly impact operations and financial management, while also leading large teams and managing service delivery. Your proficiency in problem-solving, decision-making, and resource optimization will be key in driving results that accelerate our business objectives. Your role will also involve fostering strong relationships with stakeholders, interpreting regulatory requirements, and effectively communicating risk reports to various management levels. 
 
**Job responsibilities**

* Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive testing strategies across various business lines, ensuring alignment with regulatory and firm requirements.
* Oversee complex testing initiatives, utilizing advanced knowledge in risk management and control testing to identify and mitigate unmitigated risks.
* Make independent, strategic decisions that significantly impact operations, financial management, and compliance, based on in-depth analysis and expert judgment.
* Foster strong relationships with senior stakeholders, interpreting regulatory requirements and effectively communicating risk reports to various management levels.
* Manage large teams, setting professional standards, and ensuring efficient service delivery, while also contributing to the longer-term plans for the area to fit within broader functional and organization strategy.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 10 years of experience in leading and implementing comprehensive testing strategies in a financial institution.
* Proven track record in managing large teams, setting professional standards, and ensuring efficient service delivery.
* Demonstrated expertise in interpreting and applying regulatory requirements within the context of risk management and control testing.
* Advanced proficiency in utilizing risk dashboards to provide SMART risk reporting, communications, and presentations for various forums and management levels.
* Expertise in resource optimization, with a focus on efficiently leveraging allocated people, money, and technologies to plan, schedule, and progress project and program initiatives.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

Are you an experienced **Director of Quality Management (RN)** seeking a rewarding career that aligns with your lifestyle? Look no further than PAM Health, where we are proud to offer competitive rates and an extensive benefits package designed to suit your needs.

**What can PAM Health offer you?**

* **Patient-Centric Focus:** Join a hospital dedicated to delivering exceptional patient care and achieving the highest levels of patient satisfaction.
* **Career advancement:** Unlock opportunities for professional growth through our Education Advancement Program
* **Competitive compensation:** Explore our rates and take advantage of a comprehensive benefits package.
 + Medical Benefits: EPO/HDHP/HSA options; including prescription coverage, RX ‘n go, and Teladoc
 + Comprehensive dental and vision
 + Employee Assistance Program, including counseling, legal, and financial services
 + Flexible spending (FSA) and health savings (HAS) accounts
 + Life and Disability insurance benefits
 + Education/In-Service Opportunities including continuing education and tuition services
 + Supplemental benefits: Accident, critical illness, cancer, pet, and identity theft protection insurance options

Qualifications:

role.title: Director, Quality Engineering and Automation -Information technology
role.description:
Overview:

ServiceLink is seeking an experienced Director of Quality Engineering and Automation to lead our quality engineering transformation. This leader will be responsible for defining and executing the enterprise quality strategy, modernizing test automation capabilities, establishing quality governance standards, and driving engineering-wide quality improvements.

This role is not a traditional QA management position focused solely on test execution. The Director will serve as the organization’s quality engineering leader, responsible for building scalable automation capabilities, establishing meaningful quality metrics, and influencing software quality outcomes across Engineering, Product, and Release organizations.

The ideal candidate combines deep quality engineering expertise with strong organizational leadership, executive communication skills, and a proven ability to drive meaningful change in highly matrixed environments. Success in this role requires the ability to influence decisions through data, credibility, partnership, and quality leadership rather than direct organizational authority.

ServiceLink is modernizing the mortgage services industry through AI-accelerated engineering, intelligent automation, and next-generation software delivery practices. We empower the nation’s top lenders and financial institutions with advanced technology, data-driven insights, and high-velocity product development models.

As we continue to scale our technology platforms, we are investing in a modern Quality Engineering organization focused on automation, quality governance, engineering excellence, and continuous delivery. Our goal is to transform quality from a downstream testing activity into an engineering capability embedded throughout the software development lifecycle.

**This is a hybrid role, and will be required to work in-office at our Plano, TX office at least 3 days per week. Candidates must be located within reasonable commuting distance of this office and be willing to work in-office on a regular basis.**

**Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require sponsorship for employment visa status now or in the future.**

A DAY IN THE LIFE

In this role, you will…

* Lead quality engineering transformation
* Own enterprise test automation strategy
* Establish quality governance and risk management policies and procedures
* Drive engineering quality excellence
* Influence cross-functional release and product outcomes
* Establish quality metrics and executive reporting
* Lead and develop the Quality Engineering organization

Success Measures

* Automated coverage of critical business workflows.
* Reduction in manual regression testing effort.
* Improved release predictability and confidence.
* Reduction in escaped production defects.
* Increased adoption of shift-left quality practices.
* Expanded developer ownership of quality.
* Enhanced visibility into quality trends and release readiness risks.
* Increased executive confidence in quality governance and software delivery outcomes.

WHO YOU ARE

You possess …

* 10+ years of progressive experience in software quality, quality engineering, software engineering, or related technology leadership roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading quality engineering organizations in complex enterprise software environments.
* Demonstrated success leading large-scale test automation and quality transformation initiatives.
* Experience building and scaling automation frameworks and engineering quality practices.
* Strong understanding of modern SDLC practices, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and cloud-native application architectures.
* Experience implementing API, integration, end-to-end, performance, and regression testing strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and lead cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Experience establishing quality metrics, executive scorecards, and data-driven governance models.
* Strong understanding of risk management, release readiness, and quality governance practices.
* Experience managing distributed teams and complex organizational change efforts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage technical and business audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering and testing tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar technologies.

Responsibilities:

1. Lead Quality Engineering Transformation

* Define and execute a multi-year quality engineering strategy aligned with ServiceLink’s technology and business objectives.
* Transform the organization from a predominantly manual testing model to an automation-first quality engineering approach.
* Establish scalable operating models, standards, and best practices across quality engineering functions.
* Evaluate and implement AI-assisted testing capabilities where they provide measurable business value.
* Continuously improve testing effectiveness, release confidence, and overall software quality.
* Develop a strategic roadmap that reduces manual regression testing effort while improving coverage and reliability.

2. Own Enterprise Test Automation Strategy

* Define and execute automation strategies spanning unit, API, integration, end-to-end, performance, and regression testing.
* Build and maintain modern automation frameworks supporting multiple product portfolios and technology stacks.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive testing activities and reduce release-cycle effort.
* Establish automation standards, coding practices, and framework governance.
* Drive automation adoption across engineering teams and development pipelines.
* Ensure automation investments directly support business outcomes through measurable reductions in manual testing effort

and improved release quality.

3. Establish Quality Governance and Risk Management

* Define enterprise quality standards, testing policies, and release readiness criteria.
* Develop risk-based testing frameworks that focus resources on the highest-value business scenarios.
* Provide objective assessments of release readiness and software quality risks.
* Establish processes for identifying, documenting, communicating, and escalating quality concerns.
* Lead post-release reviews and quality retrospectives to identify systemic improvement opportunities.
* Create clear mechanisms for risk visibility and executive decision support.

4. Drive Engineering Quality Excellence

* Partner with software engineering leaders to embed quality throughout the SDLC.
* Champion shift-left testing practices and developer ownership of quality.
* Promote increased use of automated testing within CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive adoption of engineering practices that improve code quality, testability, maintainability, and system reliability.
* Collaborate with architecture and development teams to improve overall product quality and reduce defect introduction

rates.

* Influence engineering decisions through quality metrics, technical insights, and continuous improvement recommendations.

5. Influence Cross-Functional Release and Product Outcomes

* Build strong working relationships across Product Management, Release Management, Engineering, Operations, and

Support organizations.

* Serve as a trusted advisor on quality, testing strategy, release readiness, and operational risk.
* Influence planning, prioritization, and release decisions through data-driven recommendations and quality insights.
* Ensure stakeholders understand the quality implications of scope changes, late-stage modifications, and release decisions.
* Foster organizational alignment around quality objectives and customer experience outcomes.
* Facilitate constructive discussions regarding risk, readiness, and delivery trade-offs.

6. Establish Quality Metrics and Executive Reporting

* Define and maintain enterprise quality KPIs and executive dashboards.
* Track and communicate trends related to:

o Escaped defects

o Automation coverage

o Regression testing effort

o Test effectiveness

o Production incidents

o Release quality

o Customer-impacting defects

* Use quantitative analysis to identify improvement opportunities and support investment decisions.
* Provide executive leadership with clear visibility into quality trends, risks, and organizational progress.

7. Lead and Develop the Quality Engineering Organization

* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing quality engineering teams.
* Create career paths for automation engineers, quality engineers, and quality leaders.
* Attract and retain top quality engineering talent.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Ensure organizational structures support both immediate delivery needs and long-term quality transformation goals.

Qualifications:

Required

* 10+ years of progressive experience in software quality, quality engineering, software engineering, or related technology leadership roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading quality engineering organizations in complex enterprise software environments.
* Demonstrated success leading large-scale test automation and quality transformation initiatives.
* Experience building and scaling automation frameworks and engineering quality practices.
* Strong understanding of modern SDLC practices, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and cloud-native application architectures.
* Experience implementing API, integration, end-to-end, performance, and regression testing strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and lead cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Experience establishing quality metrics, executive scorecards, and data-driven governance models.
* Strong understanding of risk management, release readiness, and quality governance practices.
* Experience managing distributed teams and complex organizational change efforts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage technical and business audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering and testing tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar technologies.

Preferred

* Experience leading quality engineering organizations undergoing significant automation transformation.
* Background in highly regulated industries such as financial services, mortgage, banking, insurance, healthcare, or fintech.
* Experience implementing quality engineering practices within Agile and product-oriented delivery models.
* Knowledge of modern test automation platforms, quality engineering frameworks, and observability tools.
* Experience supporting large-scale digital transformation initiatives.

role.title: Head of Quality
role.description:
**About Us**
============

Det-Tronics is a global technology leader in industrial life safety, delivering advanced flame and gas detection, automation control and hazard mitigation solutions that help save lives, protect valuable assets and safeguard critical operations. With more than 50 years of experience, we serve mission-critical environments across offshore and onshore energy, gas turbines, clean energy, and industrial and defense markets. Our engineering expertise, rigorously tested products and global service capabilities help customers address complex safety challenges in some of the world’s most demanding environments. At Det-Tronics, our work has a clear purpose: advancing life safety technology to protect people, preserve assets and support reliable operations around the world.

**The Opportunity**
===================

Lead quality where product performance has a direct impact on safety—and help shape what quality can become. As Head of Quality and a member of the Senior Leadership Team, you will set the quality strategy for Det-Tronics, develop a strong organization and bring fresh thinking to how we prevent problems, learn and make decisions.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on engagement across supplier, manufacturing and product quality and the quality management system. Bring your curiosity and enjoy the challenge of modernizing how quality works: simplify processes, connect data and put digital and AI tools to practical use. You will build capability across the business and help teams reach sound decisions faster.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Quality Strategy and Team Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Translate business objectives into a quality strategy, annual operating plan, budget and resource priorities; deliver measurable results aligned with long-term growth goals.
* Lead, coach and develop the quality team; set clear expectations, strengthen technical and leadership capability, and build succession and development plans.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Management and Service to embed quality into daily decisions and resolve competing priorities.

**Organizational Training and Development**
-------------------------------------------

* Own the organization’s quality training strategy in partnership with HR and functional leaders; identify skill gaps and develop role-based learning for onboarding, qualification and ongoing development.
* Create and deliver practical training, digital learning and job aids on quality standards, procedures, problem solving and new tools; coach and verify effectiveness through demonstrated skills and performance improvements.

**Quality Management System and Compliance**
--------------------------------------------

* Own and continuously improve the quality management system, aligning standardized processes with business needs, ISO 9001 requirements and applicable customer, regulatory and approval agency requirements.
* Lead management reviews and internal and external quality audits; ensure findings are addressed promptly and corrective actions are effective and sustained.
* Strengthen document control, process discipline, traceability, change control and risk management; partner with Engineering and Approvals to maintain product compliance.

**Manufacturing and Supplier Quality**
--------------------------------------

* Improve incoming material quality and production first-pass yield; reduce defects, scrap, rework and Cost of Poor Quality through disciplined analysis and improvement projects.
* Provide leadership for supplier qualification, performance management and development in partnership with Supply Chain; ensure effective supplier corrective actions and new part qualification.
* Oversee nonconforming material controls, Material Review Board processes, inspection strategies and corrective and preventive action; verify root causes and prevent recurrence.

**Product Quality and Customer Experience**
-------------------------------------------

* Partner with Engineering and Operations throughout new product development and sustaining activities to address quality risks, establish appropriate quality controls and support production readiness.
* Lead timely containment, investigation and resolution of customer quality issues; communicate clearly with customers and internal stakeholders and turn field and warranty findings into preventive action.
* Reduce warranty costs and repeat issues while improving customer experience, loyalty and relevant feedback measures, including Net Promoter Score.

**Continuous Improvement and Performance**
------------------------------------------

* Promote a proactive quality culture through Lean and Six Sigma methods, practical problem solving and shared accountability for process and product excellence.
* Establish and review quality dashboards covering first-pass yield, supplier defects, customer complaints, warranty performance, corrective action effectiveness and Cost of Poor Quality.
* Use data to prioritize improvements, validate results and communicate progress, risks and business impact to the Senior Leadership Team.

**Digital Quality and AI**
--------------------------

* Lead a practical digital quality roadmap with IT and business partners; connect quality data, simplify workflows and automate routine reporting so teams can focus on prevention and faster decisions.
* Pilot and scale AI tools for applications such as trend detection, analysis of customer and supplier issues, knowledge retrieval and training content development; validate outputs and measure improvements in speed, quality and usability.
* Be a visible role model for digital adoption: use the tools yourself, encourage experimentation and coach teams to build confidence while protecting data and maintaining human accountability for quality decisions.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing or a related technical discipline.
* 10 or more years of progressive quality experience in manufacturing, including at least 5 years leading quality teams and improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated leadership across quality management systems, manufacturing quality, supplier quality and customer issue resolution in a technically complex or regulated product environment.
* Experience owning or leading an ISO 9001 quality management system, audits, management reviews and corrective action processes.
* Proven results improving first-pass yield, reducing Cost of Poor Quality and warranty costs, and strengthening customer satisfaction.
* Strong working knowledge of root cause analysis, CAPA, 8D, FMEA, statistical process control, process capability and measurement system analysis.
* Ability to develop people, lead organizational training and influence cross-functional teams; strong judgment, clear communication and a customer-focused approach.
* Experience translating business priorities into plans, budgets, resource decisions and measurable performance goals.
* Demonstrated ability to modernize quality processes using digital tools, analytics or automation, with curiosity and practical judgment about applying AI.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with industrial fire and gas detection, life safety products, instrumentation, electronics or electromechanical manufacturing.
* Familiarity with product certification, functional safety and approval agency requirements relevant to industrial safety products.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, ASQ quality certification, or comparable demonstrated expertise.
* Experience with APQP, PPAP, first article inspection, supplier audits and quality planning for new products.
* Experience supporting global customers or suppliers and using ERP systems, Minitab, Excel or Power BI for quality analysis and reporting.
* Experience implementing digital QMS workflows, automated dashboards or AI-enabled quality improvements, with measurable benefits and effective user adoption.

**Why Join Det-Tronics**
========================

Bring your ideas, curiosity and leadership to products that help protect lives. Work directly with senior leaders and technical teams to build skills across the organization, experiment with better ways of working and turn digital tools into meaningful improvements. This is an opportunity to make quality simpler, smarter and more engaging—and help others do the same.

role.title: Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance
role.description:
**Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance**

**Miltope Corporation**

**Hope Hull, Al**

**Position Overview**

Miltope Corporation is seeking an experienced aerospace quality and regulatory compliance executive to lead the company's Quality organization and ensure continued compliance with applicable Department of War, Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), and customer requirements.

This position has responsibility for the development, implementation, oversight, and continuous improvement of the company's quality management systems supporting but not limited to:

* FAA Part 21 Production Approval operations.
* FAA Part 145 Certified Repair Station operations.
* EASA Part 145 Approved Maintenance Organization operations.

The Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance will serve as the senior independent authority for quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and quality system effectiveness across production and repair station operations.

Reporting directly to the CEO/President, this individual will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Repair Station management to ensure that regulatory requirements are understood, implemented, monitored, and consistently maintained.

The successful candidate must possess the leadership capabilities to establish an effective quality culture while maintaining the technical knowledge and operational experience necessary to engage directly in regulatory matters, audits, investigations, and corrective action activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory Compliance and Quality System Leadership**

* Maintain overall responsibility for the effectiveness and compliance of Miltope's quality management systems supporting FAA Part 21 Production Approval and FAA/EASA Part 145 Repair Station operations.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA regulations, including 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, and applicable EASA Part-145 requirements.
* Maintain and oversee the implementation of applicable Quality Manuals, Repair Station Manuals, Quality Control Manuals, and associated procedures.
* Ensure that regulatory requirements, approved procedures, and customer-specific quality requirements are effectively communicated and implemented throughout the organization.
* Maintain awareness of regulatory changes and evaluate their impact on company operations, procedures, and approvals.
* Serve as the primary Quality organization representative in regulatory compliance matters and coordinate with designated Accountable Managers and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure that organizational responsibilities, delegated authorities, and quality reporting relationships are clearly defined and maintained.

**FAA and EASA Regulatory Oversight**

* Oversee the company's compliance with FAA Production Approval requirements, including organizational controls, production conformity, quality assurance, and product traceability.
* Oversee FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality control activities, ensuring compliance with the Repair Station Manual, Quality Control Manual, and applicable Operations Specifications.
* Ensure EASA Part-145 compliance monitoring requirements are effectively implemented and maintained.
* Ensure the designated EASA Compliance Monitoring Manager has the necessary independence, authority, resources, and organizational access to perform assigned responsibilities.
* Coordinate regulatory inspections, audits, surveillance activities, and responses to FAA and EASA findings.
* Maintain effective working relationships with FAA and EASA representatives and other applicable regulatory authorities.
* Ensure timely notification, investigation, and resolution of reportable quality and regulatory issues.

**Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and maintain an effective internal audit program covering production, repair station operations, suppliers, and supporting business functions.
* Ensure timely identification, documentation, investigation, and resolution of nonconformances and audit findings.
* Establish and maintain an effective corrective and preventive action (CAPA) process, including root cause analysis and verification of corrective action effectiveness.
* Monitor quality performance metrics, identify adverse trends, and drive improvement initiatives.
* Ensure appropriate controls for material acceptance, inspection, product conformity, nonconforming material, configuration management, calibration, and quality records.
* Oversee supplier quality management and ensure appropriate qualification, monitoring, and corrective action processes.
* Drive a culture of quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and regulatory compliance throughout the organization.

**Organizational Leadership and Executive Accountability**

* Report directly to the CEO/President and provide regular updates regarding regulatory compliance, quality performance, significant risks, and corrective action activities.
* Maintain independence from Manufacturing, Operations, and Repair Station production functions when performing quality oversight and compliance monitoring activities.
* Have authority to escalate significant quality and regulatory compliance concerns directly to executive leadership.
* Establish appropriate quality-related authority, including the ability to initiate product or maintenance holds and prevent release or return to service when applicable requirements have not been satisfied, consistent with approved procedures and delegated authority.
* Partner with functional leaders to ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained.
* Lead, develop, and mentor the Quality organization to ensure appropriate technical competency, staffing, and succession planning.
* Provide executive management with objective assessments of the effectiveness of the company's quality systems and regulatory compliance posture.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Aviation, or a related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent education and relevant aerospace industry experience will be considered.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in defense or aerospace quality assurance, regulatory compliance, manufacturing quality, or aviation maintenance quality.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing a quality organization or regulatory compliance function.
* Demonstrated experience working within an FAA-regulated aerospace manufacturing organization holding a Part 21 Production Approval.
* Direct experience with FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality systems and regulatory requirements.

role.title: Quality Management Director
role.description:
**Overview**

The Quality Management Director develops, implements, and maintains the hospital's Quality Management System in line with ISO 9001 and NIAHO standards. The director oversees the Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) program and keeps the hospital compliant with CMS Conditions of Participation and state requirements. The role leads survey and accreditation readiness, including mock surveys, tracers, and plans of correction. The director chairs or coordinates the quality committees, supervises the Quality and Compliance Associate, and monitors regulatory quality requirements. The director also oversees quality and patient safety data reporting, including dashboards and benchmarking, presented to the Medical Staff, Executive Leadership, and Board.

I. Minimum Qualifications:

A. Education:

1. Current licensure to practice as a Registered Professional Nurse in the State of Texas or equivalent degree in healthcare with a minimum of a baccalaureate degree. Master's degree in nursing, healthcare administration, quality management, or a related healthcare field preferred.

2. Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) preferred.

3. Must have at least three (3) years of experience in management or quality improvement in an accredited acute care setting.

II. Knowledge and Skills:

1. Demonstrate knowledge and leadership skills to perform duties outlined in the job description

1. Must have strong knowledge of accrediting and regulatory agency requirements

2. Must have good problem solving, interpersonal communication and project management skills

3. Must be extremely detail-oriented with respect to documentation and communication

4. Able to read and interpret medical record documentation and hospital policies and procedures

5. Must have at a minimum proficient computer skills in using Microsoft computer programs (Word, Excel, PPT, etc.)

III. Personal/Physical Requirements:

1. Mental and physical health to meet demands of position

2. Must have respect for human dignity and cultural diversity

3. Demonstrates ability in use of verbal/written communication, and effectively communicate with patients, families, hospital staff, medical staff, and general public.

IV. Data Reporting Requirements:

1. Oversees and supports the data collection, validation, analysis, and submits required quality and patient safety data to regulatory, accrediting, and governmental agencies (e.g., CMS, Texas Health and Human Services, and the hospital's accrediting organization) within required timeframes, including all mandatory quality reporting program measures applicable to a rural hospital.

2. Ensures accuracy, completeness, and integrity of abstracted and reported data through routine audits, validation processes, and corrective action when discrepancies are identified.

3. Prepares and presents routine quality dashboards, scorecards, and trend analyses to the Quality Committee, Medical Staff, Executive Leadership, and Board of Directors, at least quarterly or as required.

4. Benchmarks hospital performance against state, regional, and national comparative data and identifies opportunities for improvement.

5. Maintains confidentiality of patient, and quality data in accordance with HIPAA, and hospital policy, and retains all reports and supporting documentation per record retention requirements.

V. Oversight Responsibilities:

1. Provides oversight of the hospital-wide Quality Management System, including the Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, and ensures ongoing compliance with ISO 9001, NIAHO, CMS Conditions of Participation, and applicable state requirements.

2. Oversees survey and accreditation readiness, including mock surveys, tracer activities, and the development, implementation, and monitoring of plans of correction following internal or external surveys.

3. Oversees the work of the Quality and Compliance Associate.

4. Leads and monitors performance improvement projects, applying Lean Six Sigma and other process improvement methodologies, and tracks project outcomes and sustainability.

5. Chairs or coordinates quality committees, ensures committee minutes, action items, and follow-up are documented, and reports quality oversight activities to the Chief Executive Officer and the governing body.

Pay: From $85,000.00 per year

* AD&D insurance
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

role.title: Quality Improvement Director
role.description:
At **Valley Oaks Health**, quality improvement is about more than meeting standards—it’s about using data, collaboration, and continuous learning to make care better for the people and communities we serve.

We’re looking for a **Quality Improvement Director** to lead our organization-wide Quality Improvement and Quality Assurance (QI/QA) efforts and help turn information into meaningful, measurable improvements in care, outcomes, and operations.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead Valley Oaks Health’s QI/QA program, annual quality improvement plan, and organization-wide improvement initiatives.
* Use clinical outcomes, performance data, patient experience, safety events, quality reviews, and operational trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and monitor meaningful quality measures, dashboards, scorecards, and other tools that help leaders understand performance and take action.
* Lead quality efforts supporting our **FQHC Look-Alike and integrated care programs**, including required measures, assessments, reporting, and continuous improvement activities.
* Partner with clinical, operational, MIS, Compliance, HIM, Community Health, and executive leaders to strengthen quality and performance across the organization.
* Lead and develop QI staff while building a culture where continuous improvement and quality are shared responsibilities.

**What You'll Bring:**

* Master’s degree in Public Health, Health Administration, Nursing, Social Work, or a related field preferred; bachelor’s degree with significant QI and healthcare compliance experience required.
* **5+ years of experience** in quality improvement, healthcare compliance, or a related role.
* FQHC or integrated healthcare experience highly preferred, particularly within behavioral health and/or primary care.
* Knowledge of quality improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma and healthcare quality measures.
* Strong data analysis and reporting skills, including the ability to turn data into actionable insights; experience with Excel and Power BI preferred.
* Knowledge of HRSA, FQHC Look-Alike, healthcare regulatory, and quality requirements.
* Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills.

**Why Valley Oaks Health?**

At Valley Oaks Health, our work is grounded in our core values:

**Be Brave. Be Human. Be Connected.**

We’re looking for a leader who brings those values to quality improvement—someone who is willing to ask difficult questions, brings people together to solve problems, and uses data not just to measure performance, but to make meaningful change.

If you’re a collaborative quality leader who is passionate about **turning data into action, strengthening systems, and continually improving the care we provide, we’d love to hear from you!**

role.title: Director of Millwork Production
role.description:
About the Position

We are an established architectural woodwork and custom millwork company based in Coconut Creek, Florida, seeking an experienced Production Manager / Shop Foreman to lead the day-to-day operations of our millwork shop.

This is a hands-on leadership position for someone with strong experience in architectural millwork, custom cabinetry, woodworking, and shop production.

You will be responsible for keeping production organized and moving—from approved drawings and materials through fabrication, assembly, quality control, and preparation for delivery and installation.

We are looking for someone who can lead people, organize workflow, maintain quality, solve production problems, and take ownership of the shop floor.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily architectural millwork and cabinetry production
* Schedule and prioritize jobs based on project deadlines and installation requirements
* Assign work to shop employees and monitor production progress
* Read and interpret architectural drawings, shop drawings, elevations, details, and specifications
* Review drawings and materials before fabrication to identify missing information or potential production issues
* Coordinate closely with Project Managers regarding priorities, changes, field conditions, and project requirements
* Ensure materials, hardware, and components are available when required
* Oversee cutting, machining, fabrication, assembly, and preparation for delivery
* Maintain quality control throughout the production process
* Inspect completed work for dimensions, workmanship, drawings, specifications, and company standards
* Identify and resolve production problems quickly
* Coordinate with installation teams to ensure fabricated components are properly prepared for the field
* Track production schedules and communicate potential delays before they become critical
* Train, supervise, and hold shop personnel accountable for quality, productivity, and workmanship
* Maintain an organized, clean, and safe shop
* Improve shop workflow, organization, efficiency, and production processes
* Ensure completed millwork is properly labeled, protected, packaged, and ready for delivery
* Help maintain machinery, tools, equipment, and other shop resources
* Enforce company safety procedures and proper equipment use

Required Qualifications

* 5+ years of relevant experience in architectural millwork, custom cabinetry, woodworking, or a closely related trade
* Previous experience as a Shop Foreman, Production Manager, Millwork Foreman, Lead Carpenter, or similar leadership position
* Strong understanding of architectural millwork and custom fabrication
* Ability to read and interpret architectural plans and shop drawings
* Strong knowledge of woodworking materials, hardware, fabrication methods, and construction techniques
* Experience supervising and directing shop or production employees
* Strong understanding of quality control and professional millwork craftsmanship
* Ability to schedule and prioritize multiple projects and deadlines
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to communicate effectively with Project Managers, installers, vendors, and shop employees
* Ability to take ownership of shop operations and work independently
* Hands-on leadership style and willingness to work directly on the shop floor when needed

Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

* CNC machinery and CNC-based production
* Cabinet manufacturing
* Architectural woodwork
* High-end commercial or residential millwork
* Laminates, veneers, solid wood, and specialty materials
* Millwork hardware and specialty components
* Finishing and coordination with finishing vendors
* Cabinet Vision, AutoCAD, or similar software
* Production scheduling and job tracking systems
* Commercial construction and field installation coordination

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can run the shop—not simply supervise it.

The right person will know what is in production, what needs to be produced next, where potential problems exist, and what needs to happen to keep projects on schedule.

You should be comfortable leading employees while remaining actively involved on the shop floor.

Success in this position means maintaining an organized, productive shop that consistently produces high-quality millwork on schedule while minimizing mistakes, rework, and delays.

Compensation & Opportunity

* $80,000–$120,000 per year, depending on experience
* Bonus eligible
* Full-time position
* Stable, established architectural millwork company
* Opportunity for growth and increased responsibility
* Significant responsibility for shop operations and production
* Work on high-quality custom architectural millwork projects throughout South Florida

How to Apply

Please submit your resume through Indeed.

Candidates with direct architectural millwork or custom cabinetry experience should clearly identify that experience on their resume, including previous shop leadership responsibilities and the types of products or projects they have managed.

Pay: $95,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Relocation assistance

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

Eaton's Electrical Sector Americas - ARS/Fibrebond division is currently seeking a Plant Manager for its manufacturing operations in Minden, Louisiana. This role is a critical member of the site leadership team and is responsible for leading safe, high-quality, on-time, and cost-effective operations. Relocation assistance is available to candidates currently residing in the U.S. 
 
In this role, you will lead the Minden manufacturing site and its leadership team. You will drive strategic and operational initiatives including plant P&L, growth strategy, capacity, execution, and the direction of the team to meet and exceed short- and long-term business goals. You will foster an environment of engagement and inclusion for all employees and act with advocacy, empathy, and accountability. 
 
Fibrebond, an Eaton company, designs and manufactures pre-integrated modular buildings and power enclosures that protect mission-critical equipment for data center, industrial, utility, and communications customers. Headquartered in Minden, Louisiana, Fibrebond is known for its engineered-to-order solutions that support complex infrastructure projects across North America. In 2025, Fibrebond was acquired by Eaton, expanding Eaton's modular solutions portfolio while preserving Fibrebond's strong engineering expertise, customer focus, and manufacturing operations in Louisiana. 
 
**What you’ll need:** 

* Develop short- and long-term plans in alignment with the strategic plan and annual profit plan objectives to drive superior operational performance and financial results.
* Lead the operational management team and functional staff including Quality, OPEX, EHS and Supply Chain.
* Establish objectives and drive Key Performance Indicators across the organization ensuring continuous improvement.
* Emphasize utilization of Lean/Six Sigma manufacturing tools (Kaizen, VSM, 5S+) to lead cost improvement
* Establish and manage inventory to profit plan, driving improved and sustainable processes; execute the Supply Demand Planning (SIOP), drive ownership and collaboration across all stakeholder groups; generate forecasts that meet customer expectations.
* Champion a workplace focused on Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) to drive a zero-incident safety culture.
* Focus on Quality, early detection and escalations across the site to reduce cost, drive efficiency and ensure compliance.
* Create a culture of exceeding customer expectations, ensuring that the organization is highly responsive to customer needs.
* Demonstrate the ability to be innovative by developing and implementing creative solutions to complex problems, fostering a culture of innovation and continuously seeking opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with Human Resources to drive talent management, learning, communication, and development strategies.
* Champion and advocate for a winning plant culture aligned with the Eaton Culture Model

role.description:

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. 
 
DESCRIPTION: 
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Senior Manager, Plant/Site and contribute to global science and healthcare. You'll oversee operations at advanced facilities, ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that help our customers make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. This leadership role involves advancing operational excellence through Lean manufacturing principles, managing cross-functional teams, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 
 
As the site leader, you'll be responsible for developing and executing strategic plans, ensuring regulatory compliance, and maintaining strong customer relationships. You'll support our core values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement while cultivating a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence. This role offers the opportunity to implement positive change, support team development, and contribute to scientific advances. 
 
REQUIREMENTS: 

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in operations leadership in sophisticated manufacturing environments
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering, Science, Business Management, or related field
* Strong track record implementing Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies
* Experience leading teams in FDA-regulated, cGMP, ISO 13485, or similar quality systems
* Demonstrated financial acumen in budget management and operational cost control
* Excellence in developing and executing strategic and annual operating plans
* Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams in matrix organizations
* Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives
* Experience with quality systems, regulatory compliance, and audit management
* Expert knowledge of operational KPIs and data-driven process improvement
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills across all organizational levels

* Proficiency in leading change management initiatives

* Experience of working in a unionized environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to travel up to 10-15% as required
* Experience maintaining safety programs and environmental compliance
* Excellent vendor and customer relationship management skills

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in Connecticut is $131,300.00–$205,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Business or related technical/scientific field

* Demonstrated P&L management and operational excellence experience at scale
* Strong working knowledge of cGMP, FDA, and other relevant quality/regulatory requirements
* Experience leading and developing large, multi-functional teams
* Experience implementing continuous improvement and lean manufacturing methodologies
* Strong business acumen and analytical capabilities
* Effective communication and influence skills across all organizational levels
* Ability to implement change and deliver results in matrix environments
* Experience with ERP systems and manufacturing technologies
* Strong project management capabilities
* Strategic mindset with ability to balance short and long-term priorities

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities

**Pratt & Whitne**y is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Quality Director, Columbus Engine Center

**What You Will Do:**

* Collaborating with Operations, Engineering, and Materials teams to ensure robust processes, effective change management, and prevention-based quality measures.
* Championing product safety through operational discipline and continuous improvement on the shop floor.
* Overseeing critical compliance programs, including training, records management, audits (internal, regulator, and customer), procedures, and major investigations.
* Monitoring and reporting on key quality metrics, developing action plans to achieve organizational goals.
* Ensuring adherence to AS9100, FAA, DCMA, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Leading root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives using CORE tools.
* Driving process capability improvements, defect reduction, and first-pass yield enhancements through data-driven decision-making.
* Managing nonconforming material, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and risk assessments for critical aerospace components.

**Qualifications You Must Have**:

* Bachelor’s degree and 14 years of experience, or 12 years of experience with an Advanced degree.
* Experience in Quality Management within the Aerospace or other highly regulated manufacturing industry.
* Senior leadership or people management experience.
* Experience in Operations, Quality, or Engineering within the Aerospace manufacturing industry.

* 5+ years of experience in Operations Leadership.
* Experience leading organizations and other leaders.
* Aftermarket Aerospace / Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) experience.
* Familiarity with FAR-145 / CFR-145 Repair Station operations.
* Knowledge of FAA regulatory compliance.
* Background in Engineering.

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

As a Senior Director of Operations at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll manage complex manufacturing operations while driving strategic growth and operational excellence. This key leadership role involves directing production of high-quality products in regulated environments while ensuring exceptional customer service and compliance. You'll optimize end-to-end operations, implement continuous improvement initiatives, and develop high-performing teams aligned with our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, you'll establish and execute strategic plans, drive productivity and efficiency improvements, and support a culture focused on quality, safety and customer success. role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications. Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ means we are always evolving our portfolio of technologies to provide the latest heating, cooling, and ventilation solutions. Through the hard work of more than 11,000 employees worldwide, our Climate Solutions and Performance Technologies segments advance our purpose with systems that improve air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, lower harmful emissions, enable cleaner running vehicles, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. Modine is a global company headquartered in Racine, Wisconsin (U.S.), with operations in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. For more information about Modine, visit modine.com.

**Position Description**
------------------------

**Position Description**

The Plant Manager is the top manufacturing executive at the plant level, responsible for the overall profitability and operation of a facility with $60MM - $100MM in annual sales. This role involves leading a large team to meet business goals while ensuring compliance with corporate policies on quality, safety, and environmental standards. The ideal candidate will be a strategic leader with extensive manufacturing and management experience.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage plant profitability by achieving or exceeding annual business goals.
* Lead and develop a large team, including 8-10 departmental managers, 30-45 salaried support staff, and 200-450 production employees.
* Develop and execute short and long-range business plans to achieve plant and division goals.
* Create and manage the plant's operating budget and control expenditures.
* Ensure compliance with all quality, safety (OSHA), and environmental (EPA) regulations and corporate policies.
* Oversee all aspects of employee relations, including union contract negotiations and grievance handling, or fostering a positive non-union work environment.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customer relationships and resolve any plant-related customer issues.
* Continuously seek out and implement improvements in plant operations, such as statistical process control and speedy manufacturing.
* Serve as the company's representative to the local community and maintain positive public relations

**Required Education & Qualifications**
---------------------------------------

**Required Education & Qualifications**

* A Bachelor's degree.
* A minimum of 7-10 years of broad manufacturing experience.
* At least 3 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial role.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

**Why Choose Modine?**

**Health & Well-being:**

* Day One
* + Competitive health, dental & vision insurance coverage
 + Employee Assistance Program
* After 90 days of continuous employment
* + Maternity Leave (12 weeks at 100% pay)
 + - 8 weeks of short term disability leave paid at 100%
 - 4 weeks of paid parental leave paid at 100%
 + Paternity Leave (4 weeks at 100% pay)

**Financial Benefits:**

* 401k Retirement plan and company paid match
* Life Insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Short Term Disability (company paid)
* Long Term Disability

**Work-Life Balance:**

* Competitive time-off policies
* Tuition Reimbursement

Modine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Modine provides a competitive benefit package, which could include paid vacation, short term disability, 401(k), health, dental, vision, life insurance, flex spending benefits, tuition reimbursement, Health Savings Account and much more. Human Resources will provide more detail upon your hiring.

#LI-Onsite

role.description:
Responsibilities:

* Ensures that the facility provides the highest quality products produced in the most efficient manner within budgeted costs. Implements systems to effectively manage production schedules properly supporting the business.
* Leads the effort and drives Lean Manufacturing tools and techniques fostering continuous improvement within the facility.
* Acts in a proactive fashion in regard to problem resolution.
* Manages profit and loss for the facility and drives Plant performance and reviews KPIs regularly (Daily, Weekly and Monthly).
* Leads the overall strategic planning efforts for the location which include cost reduction initiatives, capital planning and resources as well as in other areas.
* Manages the overall safety, quality, scheduling, production, shipping, maintenance and other administrative functions for the facility.
* Leads the effort in maintaining a safe, clean and efficient operation working within all company guidelines and local/state/federal regulations.
* Strives to improve the plant’s safety accident record year over year in creating a positive safety culture for all employees.
* Conducts safety walks of the facility on a weekly basis.
* Conducts talent reviews. Trains, develops and motivates staff in an effort to optimize the workforce. Delivers performance reviews and any feedback to the team as needed.
* Conducts weekly staff meetings which focus on key operative measurements.
* Schedules and conducts plant communication meetings for all employees.
* Interfaces with customers and suppliers. Visits both as necessary.
* Works as necessary to establish positive community relationships.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

* Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Operations, or Business Management
* Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in operations, maintenance, engineering and/or process Improvement roles including managing teams of people
* Previous experience working in a Lean environment.
* Six Sigma Green or Black Belt Certification a plus
* Proven experience and record of successes in a high-speed manufacturing environment. Experience with plastic injection molding environment and metal processing/metal forming strongly preferred
* Experience in a commercial role with direct customer contact
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with process development and business process design.
* Experience managing to the ISO or equivalent quality standards
* Experience implementing and/or managing to an Operating System (example: the Toyota Production Systems)

You will lead and manage a multidisciplinary team of software developers, test engineers, designers, and technicians supporting PCBA Functional Test, End-of-Line (EOL) Test, Safety Test, and Run-In/Burn-In systems across internal and contract manufacturing sites.

* Drive a culture of technical excellence, innovation, safety, and continuous improvement.
