role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
*Are you a passionate leader energized by driving continuous improvement?* ***Winnebago Motorhome is seeking a Plant Manager to join our team based in Forest City, IA.*** *The Plant Manager leads overall operations of a soft goods manufacturing facility (cut-and-sew, upholstery, foam, and textile assembly). This expert-level role owns safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people (SQDCP) performance, deploying lean manufacturing systems (5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Kaizen) and ensuring compliance with relevant standards (RVIA, OSHA, NFPA 1192, ANSI methods as applicable). Responsibilities include strategic planning, capacity and labor management, production scheduling, quality systems oversight, supplier and materials coordination, cross-department alignment, and talent development to achieve world-class operational results.*

**Day to Day of the Role:**

* Own plant SQDCP performance; establish and drive KPIs and tiered daily management (Safety, OEE, FPY, on-time delivery, productivity, scrap, rework, etc).
* Lead daily Tier 1-3 process, Gemba walks, huddles, and visual management; drive corrective actions and sustainment.
* Implement and sustain lean systems: 5S, Standard Work, Kanban/pull systems, value stream mapping, line balancing, takt-time alignment, TPM. (Lean Six Sigma Blackbelt Preferred but not required)
* Ensure compliance with industry and regulatory requirements: Industry and lean best practices, RVIA, OSHA, EHS, NFPA 1192, and ANSI methods as applicable.
* Oversee master scheduling, capacity planning, labor planning, and materials flow to meet demand with optimal lead time and cost.
* Champion quality: PFMEA/Control Plans, incoming/in-process/final inspection, root cause analysis (8D, DMAIC), containment, and standardization.
* Optimize cutting, kitting, sewing, upholstery, and final assembly workflows; reduce WIP, increase throughput, and minimize waste.
* Manage budget, P&L elements, cost reduction, and productivity projects; implement make/buy and outsourcing strategies as needed.
* Build and mentor high-performing supervisors and hourly teams; certify skills; conduct performance reviews; drive cross-training and succession planning.
* Partner with Engineering on DFM/DFA; manage ECNs, prototypes, and ramp-to-rate.
* Own, develop, and mentor best practices for inventory and processes.
* Collaborate with Supply Chain on supplier performance, material availability, and packaging standards.
* Enforce safety culture: risk assessments (JSA), ergonomics, PPE, incident investigations, and compliance training.
* Lead continuous improvement events (Kaizen) and audits; maintain document control and training records.
* Coordinate with Customer Service/Program Management for priorities, promise dates, and escalations; communicate status and recovery plans.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.
* Associate’s degree with significant relevant experience will also be considered.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations.
* 7–10+ years of people management experience, including leading teams through change.
* Moderate to in-depth knowledge of Tools, Machines, or Equipment Required (Mechanical and digital measuring and inspection tools, tape, calipers, tension gauges, fabric weight/yardage tools, color/finish checks).
* ERP (D365) or similar modern Operations and Finance manufacturing software
* Basic office systems for analytics, drawings/specs, and work instructions.
* Practical understanding and ability to perform with Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, NX & Team Center (or similar engineering software)

role.title: Director of Production - Grand Prix Plaza
role.description:
**Grand Prix Plaza, home of the Formula 1 Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix,** is a world-class entertainment and event destination spanning approximately 39 acres in the heart of the Las Vegas Grand Prix circuit. The 300,000-square-foot facility features immersive Formula 1 attractions, premium hospitality experiences, event and meeting venues, retail, food and beverage offerings, and year-round activations that attract guests from across the globe. As both a daily operating entertainment venue and a critical component of one of the world's most recognized sporting events, Grand Prix Plaza requires a high-performing operational structure capable of delivering exceptional experiences while maintaining the highest standards of safety, service, and facility excellence.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**
=====================

The **Director of Production** serves as the leader responsible for all the experiences and production operations across Grand Prix Plaza. This position provides strategic leadership for Production, Guest Experience, Box Office, and Karting operations, ensuring all attractions, technical systems, guest interactions, and show elements consistently deliver a premium and memorable experience.

Working closely with the General Manager and cross-functional departments, the Director of Production drives operational strategy, financial performance, workforce development, guest satisfaction, and continuous innovation across the venue's immersive attractions and entertainment offerings. This role is responsible for ensuring all production and guest experience elements remain operationally ready to support daily business, private events, seasonal activations, and the Formula 1 Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
====================

* Develop and execute operational strategies that support organizational goals, business growth, and long-term venue objectives.
* Provides overall leadership and direction for Production, Guest Experience, Box Office, and Karting departments.
* Leads, develops, and mentors departmental leadership teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement.
* Establishes operational standards, guest service expectations, performance metrics, and departmental goals to drive exceptional guest satisfaction and revenue performance.
* Oversees annual operating budgets, capital planning, labor strategies, and financial performance for all production and guest-facing departments.
* Directs the planning, integration, and execution of attraction enhancements, technical upgrades, new experiences, venue activations, and special events.
* Provides executive oversight of attraction reliability, show quality, technical systems, and operational readiness across all guest-facing experiences.
* Manages key vendor relationships, production partners, service providers, and equipment suppliers to ensure performance, quality, and financial objectives are achieved.
* Partners with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to support venue-wide initiatives, operational readiness, and organizational goals.
* Ensures compliance with all applicable safety standards, operational procedures, regulatory requirements, and risk management practices associated with attractions, entertainment, and guest operations.
* Other responsibilities as assigned

**QUALIFICATIONS**
==================

* 9+ years of progressive leadership experience within entertainment venues, attractions, theme parks, sports venues, immersive experiences, or hospitality operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi-disciplinary teams across production, guest experience, attractions, entertainment, box office, or related operational functions.
* Proven experience managing operating budgets, labor planning, capital expenditures, and departmental financial performance.
* Strong knowledge of attraction operations, live entertainment production, technical systems, guest experience management, and venue operations.
* Experience overseeing third-party vendors, production contractors, service providers, and strategic partnerships.
* Knowledge of OSHA requirements, risk management practices, life safety standards, and operational compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting large-scale events, attraction launches, venue activations, or public-facing entertainment operations.
* Strong business knowledge with the ability to analyze operational metrics, guest feedback, revenue performance, and financial reporting.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**WORK SCHEDULE:**

* This is a full-time position that works a flexible schedule including weekdays, weekends, evenings, and holidays.

**SEASONAL & EVENT-BASED RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* This role includes a seasonal period during which responsibilities extend beyond standard operations. During load-in and load-out of the Grand Prix Plaza facility, race week activations, and other special projects, this position may support non-traditional functions that fall outside a routine. Flexibility, cross-functional collaboration, and adaptability are essential and required during these high-impact times.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Physical ability to walk, stand, take stairs/elevators/escalators, and navigate the elements during the day and night
* May need to remain in a sitting or standing position for prolonged periods, and repeat motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
* Ability to handle exposure to loud noises at live events, attractions, entertaining programs, and crowd
* Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times.

**Other Duties:** Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Las Vegas Grand Prix, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), parental status, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

role.title: Sr. Staff Solutions Architect – Manufacturing (R6252)
role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


Shield AI is seeking a senior Solutions Architect – Manufacturing to serve as the functional and technical authority for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP across Manufacturing, MRP/Supply Chain Planning, and the shop-floor-to-ERP technology stack. This role owns the design, configuration, and continuous improvement of Oracle Fusion Manufacturing and MRP capabilities, with deep, hands-on strength in MES, QMS, and PLM — ensuring plan, build, and quality processes operate as one coherent, well-architected system.
This is a hands-on, business-facing role. The Solutions Architect is expected to be the trusted advisor and go-to resource for Manufacturing and Quality business partners on any process change involving Oracle Fusion Manufacturing/Planning or the MES, QMS, and PLM bolt-on applications — translating business need into a scalable, well-architected solution, and then configuring and implementing that solution directly for medium-complexity projects. For large, complex initiatives, this person leads solution design and partners with Shield AI’s implementation partner to deliver, while remaining the accountable architect and voice of the business throughout.
Beyond core ERP, this role holds full ownership of Shield AI’s manufacturing-adjacent bolt-on application landscape — including MES, QMS, and PLM (Teamcenter) — and is responsible for how those systems integrate with Oracle Fusion ERP to form a coherent plan-to-build-to-quality operating model. This role partners closely with the other Solutions Architects for Supply Chain and Finance on shared MRP/planning signals, supplier quality matters tied to Procure-to-Pay and end-to-end integration with Finance/Accounting.

What you'll do: 
Solution Architecture & Business Partnership
Designs and delivers technical solutions, creates detailed solution designs, specific integration points, and selects appropriate tools and frameworks. Collaboration with developers and engineers to implement solutions, conducts technical reviews and resolves design challenges.
Documents architectures, provides technical guidance during development, and ensures solutions adhere to performance, security, and interoperability requirements. Prototypes new approaches and evaluates emerging technologies for project suitability.
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for business partners across Manufacturing, Production Planning, Quality, and Engineering on process design and system capability questions.
Act as the lead advocate for Manufacturing and Quality stakeholders in all ERP, MES, QMS, and PLM-related discussions, ensuring their operational needs, constraints, and priorities are represented in solution design.
Become the go-to resource for any proposed Manufacturing or Quality process change, evaluating impact, feasibility, and fit within the Oracle Fusion ERP data model and integration landscape before implementation.
Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs that balance standard Oracle Fusion functionality against configuration, extension, or integration needs.
Maintain a working command of adjacent end-to-end flows (Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay) to ensure Manufacturing, MRP, MES, and QMS designs do not create downstream conflicts or gaps.
Hands-On Configuration & Delivery
Directly configure Oracle Fusion Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning/MRP, Work Definitions, Quality Inspections, and related modules for medium-sized projects, enhancements, and break/fix work.
Build, test, and deploy configuration changes, including setup of Fusion functional areas, security, workflows, approval rules, and data structures related to manufacturing and planning processes.
Author functional design documents, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and process/procedure documentation to support changes made in the environment.
For large or highly complex initiatives, define solution architecture and requirements, then partner closely with the implementation partner to execute — remaining accountable for solution quality, business fit, and knowledge transfer.
Participate in and help lead workshops, fit-gap sessions, and design reviews with Manufacturing and Quality stakeholders and implementation partner teams.
MRP, MES & QMS Ownership
Own MRP and Supply Chain Planning configuration — planning parameters, supply/demand netting, exception messages, and planner workbench — ensuring plans translate cleanly into executable work orders.
Own the functional roadmap, configuration governance, and business alignment for:
– MES (Manufacturing Execution System) — work order execution, shop-floor data collection, routing/operation tracking
– QMS (Quality Management System) — inspections, non-conformance, corrective/preventive action (CAPA), supplier quality
– PLM – Teamcenter — engineering BOM, item master, and change management integration with Oracle Fusion
Ensure MES, QMS, and PLM remain architecturally aligned with Oracle Fusion Manufacturing and MRP, avoiding duplicate data ownership, conflicting BOM/routing data, or process gaps across systems.
Define and maintain the target integration model between MES, QMS, PLM, and Oracle Fusion ERP, including engineering-to-manufacturing BOM transfer and quality event-to-ERP disposition flows.
Partner with the Solutions Architect – Supply Chain on supplier-quality data flowing from Procure-to-Pay into QMS-driven supplier corrective action processes.
Integrations
Design and help implement integrations between Oracle Fusion ERP and MES, QMS, and PLM (Teamcenter), including BOM/routing sync, work order status, and quality disposition data.
Define integration requirements, data mappings, and error-handling/reconciliation approaches in partnership with technical/integration teams.
Evaluate integration patterns (API, middleware, file-based) and recommend approaches appropriate to data volume, latency, and criticality, particularly for shop-floor/real-time data.
Support testing, cutover, and hypercare activities for integration-related changes.
Governance & Continuous Improvement
Maintain configuration standards, documentation, and change control discipline for the Manufacturing, MRP, MES, QMS, and PLM functional areas.
Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved data quality across planning, production, and quality cycles.
Stay current on Oracle Fusion quarterly releases relevant to Manufacturing and Planning, and assess/recommend adoption of new features.
Mentor junior functional/technical resources and contribute to a growing internal ERP center of excellence.
Required Qualifications:
12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise ERP systems, with significant depth in MRP/Supply Chain Planning, MES, and QMS functions.
Hands-on experience configuring Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP (Manufacturing and Planning pillars); comfortable working directly in the application, not solely at a requirements level.
Experience across multiple full-lifecycle ERP implementations (Oracle Fusion required; prior experience with Oracle EBS, SAP, or other major ERP platforms is a plus).
Direct, hands-on experience with at least one MES platform and one QMS platform, including their integration into an ERP environment.
Working knowledge of Order-to-Cash and Procure-to-Pay processes and how they interact with Manufacturing, MRP, and quality operations.
Demonstrated experience acting as a functional/solution architect — able to design solutions independently, not just execute configuration tasks handed down by others.
Experience partnering with or managing systems integrators/implementation partners on complex delivery efforts.
Strong business partnering and stakeholder management skills; comfortable being the primary escalation point for Manufacturing and Quality process questions.
Working understanding of integration concepts and experience partnering on ERP-to-MES/QMS/PLM system integrations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing functional design documents, process documentation, and executive-level updates.
Preferred Qualifications:
Prior consulting background (Big 4, Oracle partner, or boutique Oracle Fusion implementation firm) strongly preferred.
Direct experience owning or integrating PLM (Teamcenter) with Oracle Fusion Manufacturing/Engineering data.
Experience in aerospace, defense, or other regulated/complex discrete manufacturing environments.
Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or similar middleware/integration platforms.
Oracle Fusion certifications in Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, or Quality.
Experience operating in environments with export control, ITAR/CUI, or other regulated data-handling requirements.
AI & Agentic Automation Capabilities:
Shield AI is investing in Agentic AI to accelerate and automate manufacturing and quality operations. This role is expected to actively identify, design, and help implement AI-driven automation across Manufacturing, MRP, MES, and QMS — not simply consume AI tools built by others.
Identify high-value candidates for Agentic AI automation within Manufacturing and Quality — e.g., planner workbench exception triage, shop-floor anomaly detection, quality non-conformance routing/CAPA drafting, and work order scheduling recommendations.
Design and configure AI agent workflows using Oracle’s embedded AI/ML and agentic capabilities (e.g., Oracle Fusion AI agents, OCI Generative AI, Redwood/AI-driven planning recommendations) as they become available across Fusion Manufacturing and Planning.
Partner with IT/data teams to define prompts, guardrails, data inputs, and approval/exception paths for AI agents acting on manufacturing and quality transactions, ensuring appropriate human-in-the-loop controls.
Evaluate and pilot third-party or custom Agentic AI tools (e.g., for predictive maintenance, quality defect pattern detection, MES data synthesis, or supply/demand sensing) and assess fit against the target architecture.
Use AI-assisted tools for day-to-day solution work — requirements analysis, test script generation, configuration documentation, and data mapping — to increase delivery speed and quality.
Bring or build fluency in prompt engineering and AI workflow design; prior hands-on experience with generative AI or agentic AI platforms (Oracle AI Agent Studio, OCI Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, UiPath/Automation Anywhere agentic features, or similar) is a strong plus.
Champion responsible AI adoption — data quality, auditability, and change management — when introducing agentic workflows into regulated, ITAR/CUI-sensitive environments.
Full-time regular employee offer package:
Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity
 
Temporary employee offer package:
Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)
 
Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.
 
###
 
Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

role.title: Plant Manager-Fort Worth (Stellar Energy)
role.description:
Location Haslet, Texas, United States of America Category Global Integrated Supply Chain Job Id JR-17270 Commercial HVAC Americas

 

Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

 
 

Learn about our benefits designed for you to thrive at work and at home.

 
 

We boldly go.

 
 

**Where is the work:**

On-Site (5 days) 

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The Plant Manager will plan, organize, staff, and direct all activities of our Haslet, TX manufacturing facility, a key site for producing state-of-the-art modular chiller plant systems that provide critical cooling for data centers. Reporting to the VP of Manufacturing, this leader will be responsible for achieving plant and sector goals for safety, quality, growth, profitability, productivity, customer satisfaction, and employee engagement. The Plant Manager will also lead all production and plant operations to ensure the effective utilization of resources in a dynamic engineer-to-order (ETO) environment.

**Position Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* **Operational Leadership:** Direct and coordinate all plant functions, including Manufacturing Operations, Materials, Production Control, Purchasing, Quality Assurance, Planning, Human Resources, Accounting, Manufacturing Engineering, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EH&S). This plant is a green field site in-process of rapidly ramping up volume with employee, revenue, and output.
* **Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S):** Guide and support the plant EH&S program in improvements, investigations, and corrective actions to meet and exceed federal laws, state regulations, and corporate standards.
* **Quality Assurance:** Drive the plant's quality system, implementing
 
 procedures and controls to improve overall customer satisfaction, DPPM, first-pass yield, and warranty results.
* **Operational Excellence:** Partner with the Operational Excellence team to ensure the effective development and delivery of programs to teach the workforce lean manufacturing concepts such as A3 thinking, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, and 5S.
* **Customer Satisfaction:** Be proactive and responsive to all facets of customer satisfaction, including on-time delivery, schedule changes, and special instructions.
* **Facility & Maintenance:** Guide and support plant maintenance, process improvements, facility enhancements, and capital expenditures.
* **Financial Management:** Direct the submittal of the plant’s Annual Operating Plan and the business’s financial forecasts. Lead plant resources in project budgets, while meeting material and labor productivity targets.
* **Employee Engagement:** Maintain a positive rapport with all levels of the organization to foster and promote an inclusive work environment, high morale, and strong employee engagement.
* **Talent Development:** Lead and support the development of plant employees and succession planning activities.

**Experience and Skills Required**
----------------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related field is required; MBA or master’s in engineering is preferred.
* **Lean Manufacturing:** Demonstrated experience with implementing a Lean/Operational Excellence culture in a manufacturing environment is required.
* **Professional Experience:** 10–15 years of progressive Operations/Supply Chain experience in manufacturing operations; with a minimum of 5 years in a manufacturing/plant operations leadership role (preferably as a Plant Manager).
* **Labor Experience:** Experience working with a high-skill work force is a significant plus.
* **Strategic Capability:** Proficiency in developing and implementing strategic plans and managing a complex P&L.
* **Technical Skills:** Strong technical problem-solving skills, expertise in Supply Chain Management, and advanced leadership abilities. Experience in product manufacturing including welding, pipe fitting, and/or electrical a plus.

**Annual Base Salary Range or Hourly Base Pay Range:**

$198,993.33 - $268,730.00

**Compensation Type:**

Salary

**Incentive Eligible:**

Yes

**Sales Commission Eligible:**

No

**Disclaimer**: We strive to provide competitive compensation for this position, tailored to a variety of factors. The actual compensation will depend on elements such as seniority, merit, geographic location, education, experience, travel requirements, and union designation. Our compensation range is generally based on the national average for the country. Additionally, benefits may vary depending on the region, business alignment, union involvement, and employee status.

**Thrive at work and at home:**

 
 

* Benefits kick in on DAY ONE for you and your family, including health insurance and holistic wellness programs that include generous incentives – WE DARE TO CARE!
* Family building benefits include fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy assistance.
* Paid time off includes up to 15 vacation days, paid holidays, sick leave, and additional options to support volunteer and parental leave.
401K match up, educational and training opportunities through company programs along with tuition assistance and student debt support. 

 

Disclaimer: Benefit offerings may vary by site as well as Collective Bargaining Agreements and local/state regulations

 
 

**Safety Sensitive Role:**

Yes

The company designates certain roles as Safety Sensitive. Safety Sensitive roles may require that you pass additional drug screening.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

role.title: Plant Manager I
role.description:
**Plant Manager I**

850 W Gowen Rd, Boise, ID 83705, USA

Full-time

**Job Description**

Norco is currently seeking an individual to fill our Plant Manager I position. The Plant Manager I is accountable for the overall safe, compliant, reliable, efficient, and financially responsible operation of the production facility. The position establishes facility strategy and operating priorities, develops the leadership team, allocates resources, manages operational and regulatory risk, drives performance, and leads long-term improvement to support production capacity, customer service, and business continuity. Other responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

**Plant Leadership and Strategy**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the production facility and assigned support functions.
* Establish facility goals, staffing plans, operating priorities, budgets, capital priorities, reliability priorities, and improvement strategies.
* Maintain overall facility accountability for employee safety, product quality, regulatory compliance, customer service, production capacity, equipment reliability, operating cost, inventory control, and business continuity.
 

**Leadership Development and Organizational Capability**

* Build, direct, and develop the plant leadership team; establish clear accountability for supervisors and managers; assess leadership effectiveness; and maintain succession and development plans for critical facility roles.
* Approve or recommend hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, and termination decisions within assigned authority.

**Operational and Financial Performance**

* Review plant performance through KPI's, safety, quality, production, service, labor, training, inventory, maintenance, downtime, and financial measures.
* Require recovery plans and corrective action when plant or department performance does not meet expectations.
* Plan and request approval for operating expenditures, capital projects, staffing changes, and other resources needed to meet business requirements.
* Balance production capacity, service requirements, operating cost, equipment reliability, inventory, and plant resources when making operating decisions.
* Approve major operating commitments and significant resource decisions within assigned authority.

**Safety, Quality, and Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure operations are conducted in accordance with applicable company safety rules, procedures, work instructions, quality requirements, and assigned personal protective equipment requirements.
* Ensure required production and regulated records receive review and approval by properly trained and authorized personnel.
* Lead or oversee significant incidents, root-cause analyses, corrective actions, audit responses, product-quality events, regulatory interactions, service disruptions, and business-continuity responses. 
 Cross-Functional Leadership
* Coordinate significant facility matters with Gas Operations, Quality, Safety, Human Resources, Sales, Customer Service, Distribution, Maintenance, Procurement, Finance, Information Technology, and branch leadership.
* Communicate plant risks, performance, operating constraints, resource needs, and significant decisions clearly and promptly to appropriate stakeholders.
* Participate in company planning, leadership meetings, management reviews, emergency response, and special projects.
* Maintain sufficient technical knowledge to evaluate operating risk and make informed management decisions.
* Stay informed of and adhere to company policies and procedures.

**Supervision**

* Incumbent works under general supervision and exercises substantial independent judgment within established company policies, approved budgets, regulatory requirements, and assigned authority.

**Organizational Role**

* Manager - plans and assigns work to accomplish facility and departmental goals; responsible for leadership, hiring, employee development, performance management, resource allocation, and operating outcomes for assigned employees and functions.

**Qualifications**

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Five years of progressively responsible experience in production, manufacturing, compressed gas, chemical processing, distribution, or a related operational environment.
* Three years of successful experience leading supervisors, departments, or comparable operational workgroups.
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.
* Valid driver's license.
* Forklift certification or ability to become certified if required.
* Comprehensive understanding of production leadership, safety management, quality systems, regulatory compliance, operating risk, budgeting, capital planning, and resource allocation.
* Working knowledge of industrial, medical, specialty, and fuel gases; cylinders; production equipment; cylinder maintenance; material handling; loading; and related plant operations.
* Ability to lead managers and supervisors, establish accountability, develop employees, and support succession planning.
* Strong judgment regarding safety, regulatory, legal, operational, customer-service, reputational, and financial risk.
* Excellent organizational, decision-making, root-cause analysis, change-management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial measures and translate findings into effective priorities and corrective actions.
* Ability to communicate concisely with employees, branch personnel, company leadership, customers, contractors, auditors, and regulators.
* Ability to safely handle compressed gas cylinders and use material-handling aids as required.

**Preferred Education and Experience**:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, physical science, operations management, or a related field.
* Experience in compressed gas production, medical gas production, specialty gas operations, fuel gas operations, cylinder maintenance, or regulated manufacturing.
* Experience with quality assurance, audits, regulated documentation, budgets, capital projects, reliability, and continuous improvement.

**Additional information**

Norco offers a competitive compensation/benefit package, including:

* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Health, Vision and Dental Insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Medical and Dependent Care Flex Accounts (FSA)
* Life Insurance provided at no cost to employee by Norco
* Supplemental Accident, Disease, and Life Insurance options
* Employee Tuition Reimbursement
* 401(k) with Employer Matching
* Employee Discount on products sold by Norco

**Company Description**

Founded in 1948, Norco is headquartered in Boise, Idaho and has more than 70 branches in Idaho, Montana, Oregon, Nevada, Washington, Utah and Wyoming. As a family and employee owned company we operate the nation's largest independent gas manufacturer/distributor of welding, safety, medical equipment and supplies. Norco is proud to be among the thousands of privately-owned businesses nationwide that offer their employees a meaningful stake in the business through employee stock ownership (ESOP).

At Norco we share a common mission: "Serving You Better." Treating customers, suppliers and each other with respect and dignity is our top priority. We work hard every day to serve others and create rich lives for our employees, their families, and the communities where we work and live.

**Norco, Inc is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer**

Norco provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

**Norco, Inc is a Drug-Free workplace.**

role.description:
About the Opportunity:

Are you a proven leader who thrives on building strong teams and delivering exceptional service? At SRM Concrete, our Plant Managers are the driving force behind our commitment to operational excellence and customer satisfaction. As a Plant Manager, you’ll lead by example—empowering your team, optimizing daily operations, and ensuring every load meets the highest standards of safety, quality, and service.

If you’re passionate about leadership, logistics, and making a positive impact in your community, this is your opportunity to join a company that values integrity, teamwork, and growth.

Your Mission & Key Responsibilities:

* Lead with purpose: Inspire, coach, and develop your plant team to achieve operational excellence and deliver outstanding service to every customer.
* Oversee daily plant operations: Manage staff scheduling, load planning, and route optimization to ensure efficient and timely concrete deliveries.
* Champion customer service: Collaborate with drivers, dispatch, and sales teams to exceed customer expectations and resolve any issues with urgency and care.
* Drive performance: Implement and monitor key metrics to assess plant efficiency, productivity, and service quality.
* Foster a culture of safety: Ensure full compliance with safety regulations and company policies, creating a safe and positive work environment for all.
* Promote teamwork: Conduct regular meetings to review performance, address challenges, and celebrate successes.
* Build relationships: Develop strong connections with customers, suppliers, and SRM team members to support seamless operations.
* Contribute to growth: Participate in strategic planning and budgeting, sharing insights to enhance plant efficiency and profitability.

What Sets You Apart:

* Inspirational leadership style with a passion for developing high-performing teams.
* Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and building lasting relationships.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills; able to prioritize and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep understanding of logistics, supply chain management, or plant operations—experience in the concrete or construction industry is highly valued.
* Proficiency with dispatch software, Microsoft Office Suite, and a willingness to learn new systems.
* Knowledge of DOT regulations and safety standards for transportation and delivery.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; you build trust with team members, customers, and partners.
* Dedication to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Willingness to undergo SRM’s pre-employment screenings.

About SRM:

SRM Concrete (Smyrna Ready Mix) is a family-owned, values-driven leader in the ready mix concrete industry. Founded in 1999 with a single plant in Smyrna, Tennessee, we’ve grown to over 600 locations nationwide by focusing on quality, integrity, and service. Our mission is to serve our customers, our communities, and our team members with excellence—every load, every day.Why Join SRM Concrete?

**Why Join SRM Concrete?**

* **Growth & Advancement:** Be part of a rapidly expanding company with real opportunities to grow your career.
* **Impact:** Lead a team that plays a pivotal role in building America’s future.
* **Competitive Pay & Exceptional Benefits:** Low-cost medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance; paid holidays; PTO/vacation; 401k with $100 weekly match; family days; and more!
* **Team Culture:** We value hard work, respect, and teamwork. We support each other, recognize a job well done, and believe in doing what’s right—on the job and in the community. You’ll find a straightforward, dependable environment where every team member matters.

At SRM Concrete, you’re more than a manager—you’re a valued team member helping to build America’s future. If you’re ready to say “YES” to new opportunities and deliver service that sets the standard in our industry, apply today and join the SRM family!

role.title: Technical Director Pre Production
role.description:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

The Opportunity:

 
 

The Pre-Production Technical Director is responsible for supporting creative and visual objectives through pipeline troubleshooting, user support, technical direction, and tool development for front-end craft groups, including Story, Edit, Art, Concept, Design, Visual Development, and Previs. As a technical expert, the Pre-Production Technical Director exhibits a deep understanding of processes, technology, and tools within these domains. They contribute technical expertise to the design and development of artist workflows and tools, ensuring that the pre-production process is efficient and integrated with the overall production pipeline.

 
 

What You’ll Do:

 
 

Technical Responsibilities:

* Understand the visual requirements for productions and suggest new technologies, or design procedures, techniques, and tools to meet these requirements.
* Provide technical expertise and guidance for all technology within the Pre-Production department.
* Contribute to the direction, evolution, and maintenance of the technology within the Pre-Production Department.
* Design, develop, and write well-maintainable and consistently high-quality code.
* Track and resolve the most complex technical issues within Pre-Production in partnership with other TDs and Software Engineers.
* Work closely with other TDs and Software Engineers within Pre-Production to drive the technical success of key development initiatives.
* Ensure that technology, tools, and procedures within the Pre-Production Craft Group support the creative process.
* Provide solutions to visual problems through existing tools or by leading the implementation of new tools.
* Take responsibility for the troubleshooting and optimization of Pre-Production tools, software, and workflows.
* Actively drive the QA, technical testing, and validation of new technology, tool releases, or pipeline changes, ensuring artist workflow is not impacted.
* Understand the processes of adjoining departments and provide input where required to maximize pipeline efficiency and quality.
* Actively participate in brainstorming and problem-solving, contributing technical expertise and insight to create and maintain technology within the canonical production pipeline.
* Support the organization’s overall technical goals as required.
 

 

Bidding & Scheduling Responsibilities:

* Be aware of the deadlines for own development initiatives and actively engage in keeping these on track.
* Continuously monitor the scope of the most technically challenging development initiatives within the Pre-Production department and help to ensure scope adjustments have additional estimates, etc.
* Prioritize and break down technical projects into organized parts.
* Work with the Supervising TD to prepare estimates and pitches as required.
 

 

Talent & Performance Management Responsibilities:

* Work with the Supervising TD for Front-End to provide technical guidance to Pre-Production TDs with day-to-day issues and escalate through the right channels when necessary.
* Work with Technology Talent Management and Supervising TDs to help further develop the skills and abilities of mid-level TDs within the Front End Craft Group.
* Mentor mid-level TDs within the team and assist in orientation with senior new starters.
* Create synergies between different work groups to promote efficiency and optimization and to generate innovative ideas and approaches to how we do things.
 

 

Communication Collaboration & Relationship Development Responsibilities:

* Strong communication skills for technical ideas, project status, problems, requirements, rollout plans, etc.
* Able to communicate with Program Managers to contribute to the scheduling and planning of complex technology initiatives.
* Able to discuss complex issues with Senior Software Engineers, developers, and supervisors.
* Able to present to small teams (tool demos, Show Contract process, Support Dashboards, etc.).
* Good written communication skills for specs, tickets, status updates, etc.
 

 

Behaviours:

* Takes a collaborative approach, always working towards team goals and success.
* Is artist-focused, passionate about improving the artist experience and workflow.
* Acts as a proactive contributor, eager to learn and help the team succeed.
* Stays supportive and approachable, fostering a friendly and open environment.
* Is detail-oriented, ensuring high standards in all work.
* Remains trustworthy and reliable in all responsibilities.
 

 

What You’ll Need:

* Relevant education in software engineering and/or film creation process.
* 5+ years of proven pipeline TD experience in large-scale animated features, animated TV series, games and/or VFX feature films.
* Proven technical achievements within feature animation or VFX.
* An understanding of traditional techniques appropriate to the Pre-Production craft group.
* Comprehensive experience using and troubleshooting in relevant software such as Maya, Flix, Avid, Storyboard Pro, Premiere, Photoshop, and other related software used in the Pre-Production domain.
* Comprehensive understanding of technical details within the Pre-Production department.
* Ability to code review and troubleshoot problems as they arise.
* Expert knowledge in Python as well as PyQt or another GUI toolkit.
* Knowledge of concepts like data flow, data dependencies, metadata, publishing, and retrieval.
* Solid understanding of C++ is a plus. A strong understanding of USD and its general concepts.
* Knowledge of Flow Production Tracking (ShotGrid).
* Knowledge of code management software such as git and GitHub and code review processes.
* Knowledge of software development practices such as Agile and how to apply them in software such as Jira.
* Degree in Animation, Film, Computer Science, Design, Engineering, Math, or Physics, or equivalent combination of education and work experience in animation/VFX.
 

 

At NAS, we carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors to determine your compensation. We rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, location, skills, and experience. The overall market range for this role is typically $120,000 - $180,000 USD. This reflects total compensation; we do not have bonuses.
 
 
This job may be covered by a collective bargaining agreement. If so, pay for the position is governed by the currently effective applicable collective bargaining agreement and thus will be no less than $64.94/hr and up to any better conditions and terms negotiated and obtained as expressly provided therein.

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
**Definition:**

The Director of Operations is responsible for planning, directing, and coordinating the overall field operations of a business unit throughout a designated geographical area. Duties and responsibilities include formulating processes and best practices, managing daily operations and clinical compliance, and effectively and efficiently planning and executing the use of equipment, materials, and personnel to best meet the needs of customers, facilities, and the community in which it serves.

**Specific Duties:**

* Demonstrates complete knowledge, understanding and compliance of company policies and procedures.
* Works with the Business Leaders on developing strategic plan.
* Works with Business Leaders on developing and meeting annual budget.
* Responsible for overall profit and loss management of operations.
* Responsible for managing local vendor relations and accounts payable management.
* Responsible for monitoring staffing levels in all operations in order to maintain operational efficiency.
* Ensures that all field staff maintain a high level of customer service when dealing with patients, patient families, co-responders, other healthcare providers and the general public.
* Ensures that all field staff in all operations maintain appropriate certification and licensure for their position.
* Ensures security and privacy of all company and patient information at all times in accordance HIPPA and all other local, state and federal regulations.
* Ensures that all operations are in full compliance with all local, state and federal regulations regarding the ordering, storage, use and record keeping of controlled substances.
* Ensures that all operations are in full compliance with all company policies regarding clinical protocols and field documentation.
* Ensures that all operations are in full compliance with all local, state and federal contracts, regulations and ordinances.
* Displays a positive mental attitude toward the position held, the company, and its employees, clients, partners or affiliates.
* Clearly, effectively, and professionally express him/herself verbally and in writing,
* Responds to all incidents involving serious personal injury, excessive damage to company equipment or excessive damage to private property involving company personnel or equipment.
* Monitor the use of services, vehicles, equipment, facilities, and staff to ensure effective use of resources and assess the need for additional staff, equipment, and services.
* Review and analyze facility activities and data to aid planning and risk management to improve service utilization and quality.
* Direct, supervise and evaluate work activities of all personnel assigned to the Operations Division.
* Facilitate communication between EMS staff, support staff, and members of management as appropriate.
* Establish and implement operations division policies, goals, objectives, and procedures.
* Review financial statements, sales and activity reports, and other performance data to measure productivity and goal achievement and to determine areas needing cost reduction and program improvement.
* Responsible for annual re-certification of all ambulances.
* Maintains and ensures compliance of Standard Operating Procedures for all company operations.
* Ensures completion of annual skills evaluation for all personnel as needed.
* Assists other division directors as needed.
* Develop and maintain computerized record management systems to store, process data, and produce reports, such as personnel activities and information.
* Coordinate activities as appropriate with other division leaders concerned with reference to pricing, sales, training, human resources or distribution of services.
* Determine staffing requirements, and assist other division directors with interviewing, hiring and training new employees as needed.
* Maintain awareness of advances in EMS diagnostic and treatment equipment, data processing technology, government regulations, health insurance changes, and financing options.
* Performs other duties as directed by management.

#IND1

**Minimum Requirements:**

* All Paramedic requirements (Current Paramedic Certification)
 + Must possess a high degree of personal integrity and responsibility.
 + Currently licensed, certified or registered by the appropriate state agencies.
 + Currently certified in CPR by the AHA or other appropriate organization.
 + Currently certified in ACLS, PALS and/or other specialty certifications as required.
 + Currently licensed with the appropriate level of state motor vehicle operator’s license.
 + Currently has a clean driving record in accordance with company standards.
 + Must have and demonstrate the ability to work effectively with minimal supervision, using good judgment.
 + Must have and demonstrate the ability to work efficiently and interact in a constructive and professional manner with other employees, public safety personnel and medical staff.
 + Must have and demonstrate the ability to interact effectively and professionally with patients, customers, clients, family members, bystanders, and the general public in such a manner as to reflect positively on the company.
 + Must demonstrate a level of skill and ability consistent with the provision of high-quality patient care.
 + Must have and demonstrate the ability to perform effectively as team leader and team member in patient care situations.
 + Must have and demonstrate the ability to perform effectively in carrying out public relations and community education functions with members of the medical community and general public in promoting the company.
* All Paramedic Field Supervisor requirements
* Must have and demonstrate the ability function as a leader evaluating, coaching, training and directing field staff.
* Must have and demonstrate solid business management and administrative skills

**Physical Requirements:**

* The ability to reach, push and pull.
* The ability to sit or stand for long periods of time.
* The ability to complete all job duties during any and all hours of the day and night.
* The ability to use mouse or keyboard to input data into computer over long periods of time.
* The ability to view graphic and text data on multiple computer screens for long periods of times.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

 

**Pratt & Whitne**y is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Quality Director, Columbus Engine Center

**What You Will Do:**

* As the Quality Director for the Columbus Engine Center, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring a "quality-first" culture within a large, dynamic organization. You will lead strategic initiatives to enhance product safety, compliance, and operational excellence, while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities will include:
* Providing strategic leadership for all Quality Assurance, Quality Control, and inspection activities across the Columbus Engine Center.
* Collaborating with Operations, Engineering, and Materials teams to ensure robust processes, effective change management, and prevention-based quality measures.
* Championing product safety through operational discipline and continuous improvement on the shop floor.
* Overseeing critical compliance programs, including training, records management, audits (internal, regulator, and customer), procedures, and major investigations.
* Monitoring and reporting on key quality metrics, developing action plans to achieve organizational goals.
* Ensuring adherence to AS9100, FAA, DCMA, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Leading root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives using CORE tools.
* Driving process capability improvements, defect reduction, and first-pass yield enhancements through data-driven decision-making.
* Managing nonconforming material, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and risk assessments for critical aerospace components.

**Qualifications You Must Have**:

* Bachelor’s degree and 14 years of experience, or 12 years of experience with an Advanced degree.
* Experience in Quality Management within the Aerospace or other highly regulated manufacturing industry.
* Senior leadership or people management experience.
* Experience in Operations, Quality, or Engineering within the Aerospace manufacturing industry.

**Qualifications We Prefer**:

* 5+ years of experience in Operations Leadership.
* Experience leading organizations and other leaders.
* Aftermarket Aerospace / Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) experience.
* Familiarity with FAR-145 / CFR-145 Repair Station operations.
* Knowledge of FAA regulatory compliance.
* Background in Engineering.
* Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) Certification.
* Experience with SAP Quality systems.
* Understanding of AS9100 and Quality Management Systems (QMS).

Learn More & Apply Now!

role.title: Director of Quality – Women’s and Children Services
role.description:
**A Brief Overview** 
The Director of Quality, Safety, Accreditation and Policy provides strategic and operational leadership for clinical 
quality, patient safety, regulatory readiness, accreditation compliance, and organizational policy management 
across a large, complex medical center. The Director establishes priorities, ensures alignment across clinical and 
operational functions, and partners with physician, nursing, operational, and administrative executives to 
advance high reliability, continuous improvement, regulatory excellence, and patient-centered care. This position 
has accountability for the design, execution, and sustained performance of quality improvement, patient safety, 
accreditation, policy governance, performance measurement, and regulatory compliance programs. The Director 
translates organizational strategy into medical center-wide priorities, evaluates performance and risk, directs 
corrective action, and provides executive leaders with recommendations needed to achieve organizational goals 
and external standards. 
What You Will Do 

* Quality and Performance Improvement
* Establish and lead the organization's quality, safety, accreditation, and policy strategy in alignment with

organizational strategy and medical center priorities. 

* Set the performance improvement agenda and direct organization-wide and departmental initiatives,

including prioritization, resource allocation, accountability, and sustainability of results. 

* Establish performance expectations and governance for key quality indicators, publicly reported

measures, regulatory metrics, and improvement commitments; intervene when performance or 
compliance is at risk. 

* Facilitate data-driven improvement efforts using Lean, Six Sigma, PDSA, and other improvement

methodologies. 

* Own the integrity, interpretation, and executive communication of quality dashboards, scorecards, and

performance reporting, including recommendations for action and escalation. 

* Partner with physician and nursing leaders to improve clinical outcomes, reliability, equity, and patient

experience. 

* Exercise decision-making authority within the assigned portfolio and escalate material quality, safety,

regulatory, or accreditation risks to executive leadership and appropriate governance bodies. 

* Define accountability structures for leaders responsible for performance improvement plans and verify

that corrective actions produce sustained results. 

* Patient Safety
* Provide leadership for the patient safety program and establish expectations for a culture of safety, high

reliability, transparency, learning, and accountability 

* Direct governance for event reporting, root cause analyses, apparent cause analyses, and corrective

action plans; ensure timely escalation, leadership accountability, and validation that risk-reduction 
actions are effective and sustained. 

* In partnership with Risk and clinical loss control, monitor serious safety events, near misses, and highreliability

metrics. 

* Collaborate with risk management, infection prevention, and operational leaders on safety priorities.
* Integrate patient safety, infection prevention, clinical risk, quality improvement, and regulatory priorities

to reduce duplication, close gaps, and promote consistent practices across care settings. 

* Support implementation of evidence-based practices to reduce preventable harm.
* Accreditation and Regulatory Compliance
* Provide oversight of Joint Commission, DNV, CMS, state, and specialty accreditation readiness,

partnering with the designated accreditation leader who directs day-to-day readiness activities to include 
establishing priorities, assigning corrective actions, and escalating unresolved compliance risks. 

* Oversee organizational responses to survey findings and regulatory deficiencies, including corrective

action governance, evidence submission, validation of sustained compliance, and executive escalation; 
monitor regulatory changes and communicate implications to leadership; and partner with operational 
leaders to address gaps and sustain compliance. 

* Policy Management and Governance
* Lead policy governance and document control processes including standards for development, approval,

publication, review, exception management, and retirement. 

* Ensure policies remain current, evidence-based, and aligned with regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate policy review cycles and approvals with clinical, operational, legal, compliance, and executive

stakeholders.

Evaluate policy compliance trends and identify improvement opportunities. 

* Resolve or escalate cross-functional policy conflicts and ensure accountable leaders address material

gaps in policy implementation or adherence. 

* Maintain oversight of organizational policy standards and publication processes. Consistent with UH

policy governance structures, accreditation, compliance, legal, quality, and operational leaders 
collaborate to ensure policy adherence and regulatory alignment. 

* Academic Mission Support
* Collaborate with medical school leadership, residency and fellowship programs, and research leadership

to integrate quality, safety, and regulatory expectations into organizational programs. 

* Support quality and safety education for medical students, residents, fellows, and faculty.
* Leadership and Operations
* Establish departmental goals, operating plans, budgets, staffing models, and resource priorities; monitor

financial and operational performance and adjust plans as organizational needs change. 

* Build leadership capability and succession plans for quality, safety, accreditation, regulatory, policy, and

performance improvement professionals; hold direct reports accountable for measurable outcomes. 

* Serve as the quality and safety advisor to executive, physician, nursing, and operational leadership,

providing independent evaluation of performance, risk, regulatory exposure, and improvement priorities. 

* Present quality, safety, accreditation, regulatory, and policy performance to governing boards, executive

committees, and medical staff leadership; recommend decisions, investments, and corrective actions. 

* Chair or lead multidisciplinary governance committees focused on quality, accreditation, safety,

regulatory compliance, and policy, with authority to establish agendas, assign accountability, and 
escalate unresolved issues. 

* Negotiate priorities and resource needs across competing operational demands while protecting

regulatory compliance, patient safety, and organizational performance. 

* Represent the medical center in organization-wide councils and, as assigned, with external regulators,

accrediting organizations, professional associations, and community partners.

**Additional Responsibilities** 

* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Complies with all policies and standards.
* For specific duties and responsibilities, refer to documentation provided by the department during

orientation. 

* Must abide by all requirements to safely and securely maintain Protected Health Information (PHI) for

our patients. Annual training, the UH Code of Conduct and UH policies and procedures are in place to 
address appropriate use of PHI in the workplace.

**Education Qualifications** 

* Bachelor's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, or

related field (Required) 

* Master's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, or related

field Preferred (Preferred)

**Experience Qualifications** 

* 8+ years of experience in healthcare quality, patient safety, accreditation, regulatory, and clinical

leadership experience with several years in people management capacity[ (Required) 

* Experience within an academic medical center, integrated delivery system, or large healthcare

organization. (Required) 
• • Experience with Joint Commission/DNV survey leadership. • Experience overseeing policy governance. 

* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior and executive leaders, managing

organizational change, and sustaining measurable results across complex operations. • Experience 
presenting to governing boards, executive committees, medical staff leadership, or comparable senior 
governance groups. • Experience managing budgets, staffing plans, and resource allocation for a 
complex function or department. (Preferred

**Licenses and Certifications** 
• • Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) • Certified Professional in Patient Safety (CPPS) • 
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent • Healthcare accreditation or regulatory certification 
(Preferred)

role.title: Director, Evaluation and Quality Assurance, Services Special Projects
role.description:
Summary
 
 
We are looking for a Director to build and lead the evaluation and quality assurance function for one of our most ambitious multi-year engineering initiatives. This is a true 0-to-1, first-key-hire role: There is no existing team, tooling, or process to inherit. You will define how we measure quality across an entire product end to end, build the automation and evaluation infrastructure to do it at scale (or borrow other teams' infrastructure), and build and lead the organization that runs it.
 
 
Description
 
 
You will own evaluation and quality assurance for every layer of the product — from whether the system is being correctly triggered for the right set of user requests, through whether it surfaces and ranks the right results, to whether the underlying transactions execute correctly, including integrations with external partner APIs, and financial systems. Quality here isn't a single test suite — it spans conversational understanding, relevance and ranking, and revenue-bearing correctness, all against a large, constantly evolving real-world dataset. You will create and drive the evaluation and quality strategy and implementation for the product. This will extensively utilize automated grading systems and human evaluation programs where appropriate. You will make the calls about where to invest in each. You will define what "correct" and "good" mean for this product, wire that definition into continuous, always-on evaluation pipelines with clear pass/fail quality gates tied to releases, and build the team, tooling, and operating rhythm to catch issues before they reach users. As the first hire in this space, you will operate with significant latitude and ambiguity — setting strategy, process, and technical direction with minimal existing scaffolding, while also building and scaling an organization. You will partner closely with engineering, applied ML, and program management leadership, including senior executive stakeholders, and you will be a key voice in defining what "done" and "shippable" mean for a product still taking shape, as well as iterating on decision points in production after the product ships.
 
 
Minimum Qualifications 
 
 

* 12+ years of experience in data science, machine learning evaluation, quality assurance, or test engineering roles in a technical product environment, including experience building and leading multi-level QA or evaluation organizations through managers.
* Demonstrated experience building an evaluation or QA function from the ground up — defining metrics, process, tooling, and organizational structure where none previously existed.
* Extensive experience utilizing LLM-based autograders and rubrics, including rubric design, evaluation set development, validation, calibration, and human-model alignment, and using them to proactively drive product and model improvements.
* Deep experience in traditional human evaluation methodology, logging, and A/B testing for consumer-facing products at scale.
* Experience evaluating conversational AI, recommendation, ranking, or search systems, and — ideally — agentic or tool-use systems that take real-world actions, not just generate responses.
* BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with quality assurance for third-party API integrations.
* Experience with logging infrastructure and instrumentation for AI product quality measurement.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of presenting quality status, risk, and trade-offs clearly to, and influencing decisions among, senior executive leadership.

 
 
 
Preferred Qualifications 
 
 

* 15+ years of experience in data science, machine learning evaluation, quality assurance, or test engineering roles in a technical product environment, including experience building and leading multi-level QA or evaluation organizations through managers.
